• Analyzes business needs, documents requirements and translates needs into functional, non-functional and/or technical specifications. Performs analysis, and evaluates downstream business, systems, process, and/or organizational impacts.
• Analyzes the process to be implemented, defines system requirements in terms of system capabilities and configures SAP.

CoVolt Power is a leading utility-scale EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) company specializing in the design and delivery of solar, battery energy storage (BESS), and high-voltage infrastructure. Since its founding in 2005, the company has built a reputation for de-risking project delivery and providing creative, integrated solutions that span the power and digital infrastructure sectors.

Consistently ranked as a top-tier EPC, CoVolt Power leverages a mission-driven approach to safety and quality, delivering thousands of megawatts in renewable assets that support a more resilient and sustainable energy future for developers, utilities, independent power producers (IPPs), and data center operators across North America.

We are seeking an Estimator at our corporate office in Albany, NY, or in a remote position.

Position Summary:

The position assumes the responsibilities of an estimator performing cost estimates for HV and MV electrical power systems, including electrical power substations and transmission/distribution systems, primarily on an EPC/turnkey/design-build basis.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities of the Position:

  • Practical knowledge and understanding of Engineering/Procurement/Construction types of projects.

  • Interface and coordinate with other departments, including preconstruction, engineering, procurement, project management and field services.

  • Review client RFP documents to determine scope, schedule and design criteria
  • Review preliminary design drawings and documents
  • Develop cost estimates for internal labor efforts, including engineering, project management, procurement, admin, etc.

· Develop detailed material takeoffs

  • Develop equipment and subcontractor bid packages/requests to solicit pricing
  • Respond to vendor and subcontractor RFI’s
  • Evaluate and levelize vendor and subcontractor bids for use in cost estimates
  • Assist in development of project proposals
  • Present cost estimates to department and company leadership
  • Assist in client bid evaluation phase, participating in cost reviews, RFI responses, etc.
  • Assist in contract development on awarded projects, ensuring contract scope and price aligns with estimate
  • Assist in project kickoff/turnover to project execution team

Educational Requirements:

Experience & Training Requirements:

3+ Years’ Experience in cost estimating of Transmission Level Substations and Transmission Lines (13.8kV – 500 kV) including:

  • All aspects of EPC substation/transmission projects

· Internal engineering costs

· Equipment and material costs

· Construction labor and materials costs

· Testing and Commissioning costs

· Overhead and general conditions costs

  • Project Management, administrative and project support costs
  • Codes and Standards: NEC, NFPA, NESC, OSHA, NERC, RUS, IEEE, ANSI, IEC, Local and Federal Building Codes

About us

We're looking for someone to own our entire performance creative system - from research and messaging to creative production, testing, and scaling winners across Meta, Google, TikTok, and advertorial funnels.

You'll have significant ownership over our creative strategy and will work directly with the founders to shape the direction of our customer acquisition efforts.

This is not a branding, social media, or content marketing role. We're looking for someone who has built and scaled direct-response paid acquisition creatives for D2C/eCommerce brands and is obsessed with performance.

  • Structured testing frameworks - one variable at a time

Success in this role is measured by improvements in ROAS, CPA, hook rate, CTR, creative win rate, and the speed and quality of creative testing and iteration.

  • 4–6+ years of experience creating performance creatives for D2C/eCommerce brands or eCommerce agencies (not B2B, not a generalist)

  • Fluent in Meta and at least one of the following: Google, TikTok Paid, or advertorial syndication (Outbrain/Taboola)
  • You've owned a creative pipeline end-to-end - from research and strategy through production, launch, and performance analysis
  • Strong written English - you write or heavily edit creative briefs, scripts, headlines, and landing page copy

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. These videos help train AI systems and robots to understand how people interact with objects in real-world environments.

Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities

  • Record everyday household activities from a first-person perspective — cooking, cleaning, tidying up, folding laundry, gardening, walking the dog, and more
  • Record in your own home, yard, garage, or workspace
  • Follow short recording guidelines per session
  • Upload videos through the project app

Requirements

  • Equipment: Own or use a smartphone or alternative camera device capable of 30 FPS or greater and 1080p resolution or greater. iPhone 12 or newer, Google Pixel 6+, or Samsung Galaxy S21+ (must have a wide-angle / 0.5x lens)
  • Capture method: Mount the device at forehead or eye-level for an egocentric perspective, maintaining a downward angle to maximize hand visibility.
  • Software: Utilize the designated "D&A" application for all data capture and upload.
  • Quality control: Ensure all video footage is clear, stable, well-lit, at least 15 seconds long, and accurately depicts useful, intentional tasks without unnecessary pauses or contrived movements.

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $6 per hour equivalent depending on the project

• This is project-based freelance work — pick up recording sessions when they fit your schedule

raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled Mobile App Developers (React Native, Flutter, Swift, or Kotlin) to join the Tendem project () and build native and cross-platform mobile applications for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your mobile engineering expertise to build stable, performant, and user-friendly applications for iOS and Android. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience shipping iOS and/or Android apps, working with platform APIs, and handling the full mobile development lifecycle.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Mobile App Developer, you'll design, build, and refine mobile applications across categories such as utilities, fitness/wellness, games, productivity, delivery, and content apps — for iOS, Android, or both, using native or cross-platform frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build mobile applications using React Native, Flutter, Swift (iOS), or Kotlin (Android).
  • Implement responsive mobile UIs that follow platform conventions (iOS HIG, Material Design).
  • Integrate native device features (camera, push notifications, location, storage, biometrics).
  • Connect apps to backend APIs, handle offline state, caching, and synchronization.
  • Implement monetization features where required (in-app purchases, ads, subscriptions).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor mobile application code to improve correctness, performance, battery efficiency, and maintainability.
  • Debug platform-specific issues and prepare builds for distribution (TestFlight, Play Console).

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in mobile app development (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in mobile application development, platform-specific UI/UX patterns, and building stable, high-quality mobile experiences for iOS and Android. We are looking for specialists who can confidently work with native or cross-platform frameworks, integrate device APIs and backend services, and build production-ready mobile applications. Strong attention to detail, performance awareness, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: React Native, Flutter, Swift/SwiftUI (iOS), or Kotlin/Jetpack Compose (Android).
  • Solid understanding of mobile UI patterns, navigation, state management, and platform guidelines.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs, handling async data, and managing local storage.
  • Familiarity with native device APIs (notifications, camera, location, storage, biometrics).
  • Experience with mobile build tools, code signing, and submission to App Store / Google Play.
  • Experience implementing in-app purchases, ads, or subscriptions is a plus.
  • Familiarity with backend services such as Firebase, Supabase, or similar is a plus.

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to performance, stability, and platform polish.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to ship complete mobile features independently.
  • Portfolio of shipped mobile apps (required, with App Store / Google Play links preferred).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $50 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

raw.description:
Company Overview

Our Mission:At Esperion, we are working tirelessly to deliver innovative medicines that help patients reach their goals today, tomorrow, and into the future.

Esperion is a fully remote based company with a corporate headquarters located in Ann Arbor, MI. The Company offers a competitive salary including a performance-based bonus program and a comprehensive benefits package including a 401(k) matching plan and health insurance, and paid time off and holidays.

Position Title: Manager, Drug Product Development and Manufacturing

The Manager, Drug Product Development and Manufacturing is a technical role that supports the development, technology transfer and manufacturing of device combination drug products at contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs). A key component of this technical role is supporting the manufacturing of commercial combination products as well as providing technical expertise for additional development and supply-chain expansion efforts. This is a remote, work from home position with approximately 25% travel.

Preferred Location: Remote – US

Essential Duties and Responsibilities*

  • Support activities for commercial manufacturing of device combination drug products at CMOs, including technical review of drug product batch records, on-site “person-in-plant” technical oversight, and support of other manufacturing activities at CMOs as required.
  • Collaborate within Tech Ops and internal project teams including Supply Chain, Quality Control, Quality Management, Regulatory Affairs, as required, for timely execution of combination product manufacturing activities.
  • Provide engineering and technical knowledge to support injection moulding, valve actuator assemblies, metering mechanisms, dimensional tolerances and functional performance, spray pattern and aerodynamic particle size distribution (APSD).
  • Maintain technical documentation of device history (DHF), process validation and commercial manufacturing, and support combination device regulatory filings.
  • Collect, analyze, and summarize data for continuous process verification (CPV) and provide input into remediation plans for identified gaps.
  • Support combination product / device-related technical activities, including coordination with device suppliers/partners on components, specifications, and technical issue resolution.
  • Partner with Quality and Regulatory to help ensure device/combination-product documentation expectations are met (e.g., device master record/device history record inputs where applicable) and support inspection readiness.
  • Ensure manufacturing changes and investigations consider combination-product requirements, including interface with design controls and risk management activities as applicable.
  • Create and review technical documents, reports, updates and presentations for cross-functional teams and management.

*additional duties and responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications (Education & Experience)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, Chemistry or closely related field from an accredited college or university, with minimum 4 years of experience with development and commercialization of device combination drug products.
  • Drug device combination product experience required, including familiarity with applicable device quality system requirements (e.g., 21 CFR Part 820/4 and ISO 13485) and risk management principles (e.g., ISO 14971) as applicable.
  • Experience in a GMP device manufacturing in pharmaceutical industry either in a research and development, process development, manufacturing, or contract manufacturing role;
  • Experience with human factor and user error engineering, dose accuracy and delivery performance, container closure systems, and extractables/leachables.
  • Solid background in device combination development, technology transfer of manufacturing processes, troubleshooting and process improvements, including experience supporting combination products and device-component interfaces
  • Experience working with contract manufacturers
  • Hands on experience with quality systems in a regulated environment, including change control, risk management, CAPA and deviations. Working knowledge and experience with SOPs and ICH guidelines.
  • Experience working in a multi-cultural, multi-lingual environment is necessary with a demonstrated ability to contribute successfully to a multi-disciplinary team environment.
  • Ability to work in a dynamic group that takes a multi-disciplined team approach to executing and achieving departmental and corporate goals.
  • Experience in statistical analysis, interpretation, and summary (control charts) of trending data preferred.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and be reliable and responsive as needed to perform responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated alignment with Esperion’s Vision, Mission, Values and Culture.
  • Proficient with office and applicable business systems including: Trackwise, Veeva, etc.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Domestic and international travel required (up to 25 %).

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Rockstar is hiring a full-time Insurance Verification & Patient Scheduling Virtual Assistant on behalf of an outpatient physical therapy practice in Manhattan.

This role is backfilling a key front desk position: insurance verifications and case completion, currently handled by a team member preparing for maternity leave. The VA will verify patient insurance coverage (commercial and Medicare), obtain pre-authorizations, and complete case reviews the day after a patient's first visit to ensure everything is accurate and ready to go. As comfort grows, the role is expected to expand into referral intake across multiple channels and new patient scheduling, including some cash-pay conversion for the practice's specialty aquatic therapy program.

This is a warm, patient-facing role once phone infrastructure is in place, so excellent, clear English communication and a genuinely warm, welcoming phone presence are essential. The practice serves a number of older patients, so being easy to understand and quick to build rapport matters as much as accuracy.

About the Client

This is an out-of-network outpatient physical therapy practice in Manhattan, home to the only aquatic therapy program of its kind in the borough. Their values center on a patient-centered approach built on connection and empathy, curiosity and openness to feedback, flexibility as a team player, respect, and a seamless, efficient patient experience.

The practice sees a high daily patient volume and values team members who are timely, communicative, and genuinely invested in patient care.

Key Responsibilities

Insurance & Case Management (Primary Focus)

  • Verify patient insurance coverage for both commercial and Medicare plans
  • Obtain pre-authorizations for procedures
  • Update patient files with accurate insurance information
  • Complete case reviews and checks the day following a patient's first visit
  • Explain insurance benefits and liaise with insurance providers to clarify coverage details

Referral Intake & Scheduling (Growing Responsibility)

  • Monitor multiple referral channels (fax, email, chat, online forms) and follow up promptly
  • Schedule new patients, including some cash-pay conversion conversations for specialty programs
  • Coordinate follow-up scheduling after initial evaluations, based on the plan of care set by the treating therapist
  • Maintain accurate patient records

Tools & Systems

  • TheraOffice (EMR)
  • VoIP phone system (in process of being implemented)
  • Team chat/messaging tool for real-time coordination with in-office staff

Requirements

  • Previous experience with insurance verifications, including both commercial and Medicare, required
  • Excellent, clear English communication and a warm, professional phone presence
  • Comfortable learning practice-specific scheduling and referral workflows
  • Some sales or conversion skill a plus, particularly for cash-pay scheduling conversations
  • Detail-oriented and comfortable managing case completion accuracy

Non-Negotiables

  • Excellent, clear English communication
  • Previous experience with insurance verifications (commercial and Medicare)
  • Warm and outgoing personality

Benefits

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience.
  • Opportunities for professional development and growth.
  • Work in a dynamic and supportive team environment.
  • Make a meaningful impact by helping to build and strengthen families across the Globe

raw.description:
About Us

We are a modern marketing collective built for scale, efficiency, and impact. As the parent company, Agital supports three specialized agencies: Go Fish Digital, REQ, and WDG, with shared infrastructure, advanced technology, and deeply experienced people, allowing each brand to do its best work.

Go Fish Digital is an engineering-forward performance marketing agency specializing in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), its Barracuda AI platform, social commerce, and conversion-focused creative.

WDG designs and builds complex enterprise web experiences for associations, nonprofits, foundations, universities, and other mission-driven organizations.

REQ is a digital marketing and communications agency specializing in brand, reputation, and advocacy for global organizations across technology, healthcare, finance, hospitality, and real estate.

Together, we operate as one collaborative ecosystem, combining deep expertise, AI-powered capabilities, and a culture of curiosity to help ambitious brands grow while creating meaningful opportunities for our people.

About the Role

Go Fish Digital is where digital marketing meets clarity, creativity, and scale. As our agency grows and evolves, we are strengthening the systems, processes, and accountability structures that support our teams, clients, and long-term profitability.

The Director of Operations will translate operational ambiguity into consistent cross-team systems and processes. This person will serve as the primary operational partner to client-delivery teams, especially account management, while gradually expanding their ownership across the broader agency.

This person will partner closely with delivery leaders to identify operational gaps, design practical solutions, document expectations, and move initiatives through implementation and adoption. The role is especially important in areas where strong ideas exist, but ownership is fragmented, processes vary by team, or operational improvements have not yet made it across the finish line.

What You'll Do

You will serve as the primary operational partner for client-delivery teams, helping turn broad expectations into clear, repeatable ways of working.

You will lead more granular operational initiatives that directly affect the client experience and the quality of delivery across teams. This may include improving how monthly and quarterly reporting is planned and executed, standardizing internal strategy meetings, clarifying how client calls and decisions are documented, strengthening cross-team collaboration, or creating more consistent expectations around account management and delivery.

You will work with functional leaders to understand what is needed, identify where responsibilities or workflows are unclear, and build solutions that are practical enough to be adopted. You will not replace delivery leadership or own service strategy; rather, you will provide the structure, project leadership, documentation, and accountability required to operationalize decisions successfully.

You will also manage the Operations Manager, oversee the execution of recurring operational processes, and gradually expand your ownership across broader agency operations.

Client-Delivery Operations

  • Serve as the primary operational partner to Client Strategy and client-delivery leadership, identifying and addressing gaps that affect client-facing work, deliverables, communication, and cross-team coordination.
  • Define clear purpose, ownership, timing, inputs, standards, and expected outcomes for key client-delivery workflows, ensuring processes remain practical, scalable, and aligned across teams.
  • Help delivery leaders move operational initiatives from discussion through documentation, implementation, adoption, and ongoing maintenance, addressing team-level practices that create unnecessary inconsistency or conflict with agency standards.

Cross-Functional Process Design and Implementation

  • Translate delivery-team needs and leadership decisions into clear workflows, responsibilities, timelines, SOPs, and measures of success.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives and working sessions that align client strategy, project management, service teams, sales, finance, and operations around clear decisions, owners, and next steps.
  • Identify and resolve root causes, handoff gaps, duplicated effort, and unclear ownership while balancing team-specific needs with agency-wide consistency and scalability.
  • Lead rollout, communication, training, adoption, and ongoing refinement of new or revised processes.

Client Lifecycle and Handoff Governance

  • Own the quality and effective facilitation of the sales-to-services handoff, client onboarding, offboarding, service changes, and other significant client transitions.
  • Establish reporting and accountability structures that surface transition risks, delays, and recurring breakdowns.
  • Ensure lessons from onboarding issues, client escalations, and post-mortems result in concrete operational improvements.

Process Governance and Accountability

  • Establish and govern clear standards, ownership, controls, documentation, reporting, and escalation paths for client-delivery processes.
  • Reinforce accountability and continuous improvement by monitoring adoption, addressing noncompliance, and leading retrospectives that resolve recurring operational issues.

Team Leadership and Operational Execution

  • Build an Operations function known for responsiveness, credibility, judgment, and follow-through.
  • Manage and develop the Operations Manager by setting clear priorities, expectations, deadlines, and quality standards.
  • Delegate day-to-day execution while remaining accountable for the accuracy, timeliness, and effectiveness of the team’s work across onboarding, systems administration, data quality, SOPs, operational support, and recurring audits.
  • Maintain a clear distinction between high-value operational ownership and lower-value administrative support.

Systems, Data, and AI Enablement

  • Oversee the governance, accuracy, and effective use of ClickUp, Salesforce, SCOPE, and other core platforms, ensuring appropriate controls are in place to support reliable data and process compliance.
  • Ensure systems support client-delivery workflows, reliable handoffs, consistent documentation, and useful reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve integrations, and reduce unnecessary manual work.
  • Lead the thoughtful adoption of AI and automation across client-delivery and operational workflows, designing well-governed solutions that improve quality, efficiency, consistency, and team capacity.

Profitability and Performance

  • Evaluate client-delivery processes through the combined lens of client experience, efficiency, scalability, risk, and margin.
  • Support reporting and improvement efforts related to client profitability, scope adherence, utilization, churn, account growth, and delivery quality.
  • Identify operational breakdowns that create rework, missed revenue, excess labor, delays, or inconsistent client experiences.
  • Partner with finance, client strategy, project management, and service leadership to improve operational and financial outcomes.
  • Establish measurable success criteria for significant operational initiatives.
  • Ensure process improvements result in practical business value rather than documentation alone.

What You Bring

Operational and Agency Experience

  • Approximately eight or more years of experience in operations, client services, project management, business operations, or a related field.
  • Meaningful experience in a marketing agency, professional-services organization, or similarly complex client-delivery environment.
  • Strong understanding of how account management, project management, service teams, sales, and finance work together.
  • Demonstrated success improving cross-functional client-delivery processes.
  • Experience taking loosely defined initiatives and moving them through implementation and adoption.

Process and Project Leadership

  • Translate broad goals and competing needs into clear, practical plans, workflows, responsibilities, and measures of success, using strong facilitation and project leadership to address root causes and move work forward.
  • Experience developing SOPs, playbooks, standards, and rollout plans.
  • Strong follow-through and a willingness to remain involved until a process is functioning consistently.

Leadership and Accountability

  • At least three years of experience managing and developing people.
  • Set priorities, delegate and inspect work, provide direct feedback, and hold stakeholders accountable while maintaining productive relationships.
  • Strong judgment when ownership is unclear, needs compete, or leaders disagree.
  • Ability to partner with functional leaders without taking over their strategic or people-management responsibilities.

Systems, Data, and AI Fluency

  • Strong working knowledge of CRM, project-management, workflow, and reporting platforms.
  • Practical experience designing AI-enabled workflows or business automations.
  • Use operational data to identify risks and guide action, evaluating potential solutions for business value, complexity, scalability, adoption, and risk.
  • Comfort learning new tools and helping others use them effectively.

Communication and Change Leadership

  • Communicate complex discussions through clear written documentation, decisions, expectations, and actions, while leading effective process rollouts, training, adoption, and change management.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with executives, functional leaders, managers, and individual contributors.
  • A calm, direct, practical communication style.

Why Join Us

You'll work alongside talented people who are passionate about solving problems, helping clients grow, and delivering meaningful results. We're a collaborative, fast-moving team where curiosity is encouraged, ideas are welcomed, and great work is recognized.

We believe the best work happens when people are trusted to take ownership, supported in their growth, and empowered to bring their unique perspectives to the table. Whether you're just getting started or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact while continuing to learn and grow.

Benefits & Compensation 

We believe great people deserve great support. Our company offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and career growth, including:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible work environment
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • Paid parental leave
  • A collaborative culture with autonomy and ownership
  • Employee wellness programs and additional perks

Additional Information

No agencies, please.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to succeed. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Please note that this job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications, which may change based on business needs.

At this time, we are unable to sponsor or transfer employment visas for this position.

We are seeking Logistics Analyst to join IQVIA Laboratories at Durham, NC.

We hire passionate innovators who drive healthcare forward through thoughtful and inclusive collaboration. If you want to discover a career with greater purpose, join us as we transform and accelerate research and development.

Job Summary:

Support the strategic direction and performance of the Logistics department by identifying and executing logistics initiatives at the local level. Provide consultation and liaison support to internal and external clients on shipping regulations, import/export requirements, and logistics initiatives in accordance with ICH E6 Good Clinical Practice.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Support the strategic direction for global logistics and execute local initiatives in accordance with project plans
  • Provide consultation to Project Management, Sponsors, and CROs to support compliance with export and import regulations and practices
  • Build and maintain collaborative working relationships with sponsors, project management, couriers, regulatory agencies, and related companies
  • Plan, coordinate, and provide leadership for complex logistics projects and regulatory logistics activities
  • Maintain and adhere to standard operating procedures related to logistics, regulations, and training
  • Monitor current data, trends, regulations, developments, and advances in logistics and regulatory areas of expertise
  • Work with global counterparts to promote compliance and facilitate global logistics standardization
  • Develop and implement new or revised processes, practices, policies, and procedures to improve logistics operations

What We Are Looking For:

  • Master's Degree preferred, Bachelor's Degree required
  • 3-4 years relevant experience including 1 year in a leadership capacity. Equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
  • Knowledge of SQL, or Power BI would be a plus
  • Comprehensive knowledge of international logistics including import/export and commercial regulations and procedures
  • Thorough knowledge of and current certification in international and domestic air transport regulations
  • General working knowledge of lab procedures - preferrable with previous experience with clinical trials
  • Other equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be accepted in lieu of degree

The Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Needed for This Role:

  • Effective oral and written communication skills
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills

raw.description:
About the Role

Regal is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Platform & Integrations to own the platform capabilities and partner ecosystem that power our digital products.

Unlike customer-facing Product Managers, this role's primary customers are developers and technical partners, both inside and outside Regal. You will define and improve the APIs, integrations, technical capabilities, and partner experiences that enable Regal's ticketing, ordering, loyalty, payments, and future digital products.

This is a highly technical product role, but not a coding role. You will have GitHub access to engage with technical documentation and develop a deep understanding of the technical landscape, but you will not be expected to write production code. You must, however, be a credible thought partner to senior engineers and able to represent Regal confidently in technical meetings with sophisticated enterprise technology partners.

You will inherit and improve existing third-party integrations, help migrate partners to better solutions, and create structure where little exists today. Success requires technical depth, external-facing judgment, clear communication, and the ability to balance conviction with patience and collaboration. This role is open to Remote US based candidates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Regal's platform and integration capabilities.
  • Define APIs, observation strategies, integration requirements, developer experiences, and partner-facing documentation standards.
  • Partner closely with Engineering as a technical product thought partner, clarifying tradeoffs, requirements, and implementation paths.
  • Lead external relationships with enterprise technology partners from evaluation through implementation, migration, and ongoing optimization.
  • Improve, replace, or modernize legacy third-party integrations while minimizing operational disruption.
  • Help internal and external developers adopt new platform capabilities and migrate away from weaker legacy solutions.
  • Communicate technical concepts, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities clearly to business and technical audiences.


Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, with meaningful ownership of APIs, integrations, platforms, enterprise systems, or technical products.
  • Strong technical acumen and credibility with engineers, architects, and external technology partners.
  • Experience managing third-party integrations, vendor relationships, and partner adoption or migration efforts.
  • Ability to define technical requirements and recognize what good API documentation and integration design look like.
  • Comfortable operating independently in ambiguous environments and creating clarity where products or processes are immature.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influence skills across technical and business teams.

Preferred

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Prior experience as a software engineer, forward-deployed engineer, backend engineer, solutions architect, technical lead, or similar technical role.
  • Deep exposure to modern .NET stack and Azure.
  • Experience writing API documentation and managing developer-facing products.
  • Experience with enterprise software vendors, payment providers, e-commerce platforms, loyalty platforms and/or integrations with third party point-of-sale sytems.
  • Experience in a non-technology company building modern product and engineering practices.

What Success Looks Like

  • Regal's integration ecosystem becomes easier for partners and internal teams to adopt and maintain.
  • Regal’s API platform migrates to cloud-native technologies.
  • Legacy integrations are improved, replaced, or modernized.
  • Strategic partners can integrate with Regal more quickly and effectively.
  • Engineering teams view Product as a credible technical thought partner.
  • Platform capabilities evolve from one-off implementations into reusable products that accelerate future digital initiatives.

About Regal

Regal Cinemas - where movie magic meets unforgettable experiences!

At Regal Cinemas, part of Regal Cineworld, each day is a celebration of everything film and entertainment. From the first popcorn crunch to the closing credits, we create moments that spark joy, laughter, and a little bit of movie magic.

With over 9,000 screens across 751 locations in 10 countries, including Cineworld, Picturehouse, Cinema City, Yes Planet, and Regal Cinemas in the U.S., we bring the joy of movies to millions.

Our Benefits

  • Free movie passes and discounted concessions
  • Paid vacation and sick leave
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Summer half-day Fridays
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance

Working closely with product leaders, platform teams, data partners, business stakeholders, and transformation leaders, this role will help accelerate AI adoption, drive measurable business impact, and ensure solutions continuously evolve based on operational feedback and emerging needs.

  • Proven people leadership and organizational development capability, with experience leading directors and senior product teams, building high performing organizations, and establishing effective product operating models and governance.
  • Strong cross functional and executive influence skills, with demonstrated success partnering across Engineering, Innovation, Commercial, Data Science, and business leadership to align strategy, prioritize investments, and drive outcomes.

Job Description Summary:

The Senior Systems Analyst Epic will play a crucial role in designing, building, testing, training, deploying, and supporting Epic applications to optimize clinical and operational workflows. This position requires a deep understanding of healthcare workflows, system integration, and project management to ensure the efficient operation of the healthcare system's IT infrastructure. Partners closely with operational leaders and end users to translate business requirements into reliable Epic configuration, integrations, and reporting—supporting safe patient care, efficient revenue cycle operations, and regulatory compliance while achieving Service Level Agreements (SLAs) relative to the supported applications. Provides technical expertise by enforcing the vision of the application and safeguarding the integrity and security of the application environment and training in collaboration and partnership with architects, tech leads and engineers. Leads process improvement activities related to Application Management and training for Epic and related third party applications. The Senior System Analyst Epic encompasses two closely related role focus areas: Application Build and Application Training. While responsibilities are similar, emphasis may vary based on team assignment.

Responsibilities And Duties:

Both RolesSystem Analysis and Design:
Engage stakeholders to gather and refine requirements, map current-state workflows, and design Epic build that aligns with operational goals and policy.
Create and maintain specifications, decision logs, and design documents for clear traceability and change control.
Conduct gap analyses to identify configuration or workflow changes needed for upgrades, regulatory changes, or new initiatives.

Project Management:

Manage smaller projects related to system implementations and upgrades.
Strong knowledge with various project management approaches, e.g. waterfall, agile.
Ability to lead project teams in project methodology.
Training and Documentation:
Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations and processes.
Mentor junior analysts and provide guidance on best practices.

Application Build RoleApplication Build, Configuration, and Deployment:
Configure records, master files, and tools (e.g., profiles, rules, security classes, workflows) aligned to approved design.
Maintain environment parity and adhere to change management and build naming conventions.
Develop and execute unit, integrated, and UAT test plans; log and resolve defects; document test evidence.
Validate interfaces, printing, reporting, and downstream workflows; confirm regression coverage in upgrades.
Coordinate release management, environment moves, and downtime procedures for upgrades and patches.
Provide go-live and post-live hypercare, including rounding, office hours, tip sheets, and at-the-elbow support.
Manage service requests and incidents ina timely manner; meet SLAs through robust triage and root-cause analysis.
Provide advanced support for (Epic, Workday, Kronos,) and other applications. Collaborate with IT and clinical teams to integrate across IT portfolio with other IT systems (e.g., Epic, 3rd Party Imaging Applications, AI, etc.).
Integration and Data Management:
Collaborate with interface teams on HL7, FHIR, PDFs, CCD/CCDA, and other exchange workflows.
Partner with analytics teams on Clarity/Caboodle extracts, registries, and operational reporting needs.
Ensure data integrity and metric definitions are consistent across modules and stakeholders. Compliance & Risk:
Support regulatory readiness (e.g., CMS, Joint Commission), audit needs, and policy alignment.
Embed privacy/security controls, including sensitive record handling and audit trails.
Contribute to ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, and configuration management processes.

Application Training RoleCurriculum Management:
Design and implement customized training programs aligned with organizational strategy and operational goals
Oversee maintenance, enhancement, and governance of the CareConnect curriculum
Ensure curriculum accuracy, consistency, and alignment with organizational priorities
Incorporate learner and stakeholder feedback into ongoing curriculum improvements
Oversee the build, maintenance, and readiness of training environments

Request/Incident Management:
Manage end‑user training‑related requests and incidents with professionalism and efficiency
Evaluate, prioritize, assign, and resolve requests within established service expectations

Collaborate with IT and operational partners to identify trends and implement preventative improvements
Refine support processes to enhance service quality and user experience

Bachelor's Degree

SPECIALIZED KNOWLEDGE

Required for Both Roles:

  • Experience with Epic application(s) and healthcare workflows (clinical, revenue cycle or IT experience).

  • Familiarity with ITIL, change control, SDLC practices, system governance, and waterfall/agile project methodologies.

raw.description:
Join a team that shares your calling

At MultiCare, you’re more than just a job title — you’re part of a team built on trust that cares for each other, our patients and our communities. Belonging here means living our mission and values every day. If your purpose and passions align with ours, you’ll find a place to grow, do meaningful work and build a career you love in a community that feels like home.

FTE: 1.0, Shift: Day, Schedule: Day

Position Summary

The HP Projects & Growth Coordinator provides Human Potential support to MultiCare in relation to all mergers and acquisition activities. The coordinator will be responsible for procuring all benefit, compensation, and other HP-related information from the seller (e.g. benefit plans and insurance rates, retirement plans, employee demographic information, employee job titles and job descriptions, employee pay, recruitment information, information about HR vendors, etc.). They will be responsible for identifying, in collaboration with the Centers of Expertise and HP Business Partners the integration plan that is best in relation to the unique transaction. They will own the integration and onboarding plan for the project, along with any related changes or adjustments. The HP Projects & Growth Coordinator will be responsible for identifying gaps and providing a detailed analysis to the Acquisition Project Team and provide recommendations as to how overcome identified gaps to have a successful transaction. All information procured will be shared within HP Centers of Expertise to ensure all of HP is in alignment and ready to support the transaction with best practices. The HP Projects & Growth Coordinator will also act as a project manager for internal HP projects and planning. They will assist in moving projects forward, maintaining notes, documents and overall timelines.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the procurement and analysis of all HP-related documents pertaining to pay, health and welfare benefits, and any HP employee-related matters (e.g. employee handbook, benefit plans and insurance rates, retirement plans (401k), employee demographic information, employee job titles and job descriptions, employee pay, etc.).
  • Takes the lead on due diligence and project calls and partners closely with the assigned project manager
  • Creates and provides a tracking mechanism for each transaction or project with real time updates.
  • Ensures HP leaders are in the loop on projects and transitions
  • Partners closely with the internal HP teams as new projects move through their lifecycle.
  • Partners closely with Benefits to compare current benefits offerings to MHS and collaborate on recommendations to be taken back to the project team.
  • Prepares presentations/communications to present or share with senior leaders for decision making and HP related updates.
  • Responsible for the internal HP management of the project and all related communications.
  • Review employee data with seller and Operations, and upon agreement, enter data into HP Portal/Workday for establishing employee profiles, and provide all employee credentials with the Integration Lead.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Human Resources, Business Administration, or other related discipline
  • Minimum of 5-7 years of Human Resources experience preferably in a Total Rewards role (benefits and compensation) with experience in mergers and acquisitions
  • High-level experience using Microsoft Office, including advanced-level experience in Excel applications (i.e. creating formulas, v-lookup, pivot tables, etc.)
  • Experience with Workday, preferred
  • Project Management experience, preferred

Why MultiCare?

Rooted in the local community

Partnering with patients, families and neighbors across the Pacific Northwest for more than 140 years.

Growth and education

Competitive tuition assistance, award-winning residencies, fellowships and career development to invest in you.

Well-being and support

Generous PTO, Code Lavender and Employee Assistance Programs to help you maintain balance and feel cared in your work and life.

Living our values

Respect, integrity, kindness and collaboration guide how we care for patients, communities and each other.

Belonging for all

Resource Groups and outreach programs help ensure every team member feels safe, seen, heard and valued.

Pacific Northwest lifestyle

Work and live where natural beauty, adventure and strong community connections are part of everyday life.

Pay and Benefit Expectations

We provide a comprehensive benefits package, including competitive salary, medical, dental and retirement benefits and paid time off. As required by various pay transparency laws, we share a competitive range of compensation for candidates hired into each position. The pay scale is $85,404.80 - $122,928.00 USD. However, pay is influenced by factors specific to applicants, including but not limited to: skill set, level of experience, and certification(s) and/or education. If this position is associated with a union contract, pay will be reflective of the appropriate step on the pay scale to which the applicant’s years of experience align.

Associated benefit information can be viewed here.

Job Title: Associate Clinical Project Management Director- CVRM

Job Location: Durham, North Carolina, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Overview

Manage and support the operational elements and execution of studies and/or programs to ensure delivery; time and quality resulting in strong financial performance and customer satisfaction and in accordance with SOPs; policies and practices from pre-award to close-out. Work with study(ies)/program(s) teams to focus on leveraging deep therapeutic expertise and IQVIA solutions to drive operational excellence and strategic leadership with our customers.

Essential Functions

  • Participate in bid defense preparations. Lead bid defense presentations in partnership with Business Development for large sized, multiple and full service, multiple country and/or multi regional studies. Understand project strategy and operationalise the agreed upon approach.
    • Develop and/or support on the preparation of integrated study management plans in collaboration with the core project team.
    • Accountable for the strategic development and execution or delivery of clinical studies in line with agreed upon contracts while optimizing speed, quality and cost of delivery, ensuring consistent use of study tools and training materials and compliance with system updates, standard processes, policies and procedures.
    • Serve as primary project oversight and/or contact with customers and own relationship with the project’s key customer contact(s), communicate/collaborate with IQVIA business development representatives as necessary.;
    • Set objectives for the core project team according to agreed upon contract, strategy and approach, effectively communicate and assess performance, providing feedback and leadership.
    • Collaborate with other functional groups within the company where necessary to support milestone achievement and to manage study issues and obstacles.
    • Monitor progress against contract and prepare/present project information proactively to all stakeholders internally and externally.
    • Supervise problem solving and resolution efforts to include management of risk, contingencies and issues. Take accountability for proactive contingency plans to mitigate risks.
    • Coach and/or mentor junior team members around project delivery, planning, project review, risk management and problem solving to ensure global alignment of work practices across the team.
    • Achieve project quality by identifyingand proactively managing quality risks and issues, responding to issues raised by project team members and planning/implementing appropriate corrective and preventative action plans.
    • May participate in executive committees as part of program leadership.
    • Ensure the financial success of the project including optimal management and assignment of resources to achieve project goals and profitability.
    • Forecast and identify opportunities to accelerate activities to bring milestones and revenue forward, implement appropriate actions to achieve.;
    • Identify changes in scope and manage change control process, including securing customer agreement to financial and milestone updates as necessary.
    • Identify and communicate lessons learned and best practices to promote continuous improvement.
    • Adopt corporate initiatives and changes, and serve as a change advocate when necessary.
    • Provide input to line managers on their project team members’ performance relative to project tasks. Support staff development. Mentor less experienced project team members on assigned projects to support their professional development.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree Life sciences or related field Req
    • Requires advanced knowledge of job area, and broad knowledge of a other related job areas, typically obtained through advanced education combined with experience. Req
    • Requires 10 years clinical research experience including 6 years of project management experience or equivalent combination of education, training and experience. Req
    • Knowledge of clinical trials - Knowledge of clinical trial conduct and skill in applying applicable clinical research regulatory requirements i.e. ICH GCP and relevant local laws, regulations and guidelines, towards clinical trial conduct. Broad protocol knowledge, therapeutic knowledge desired. Good understanding of the competitive environment and how to communicate/demonstrate value through IQVIA solutions.;
    • Communication - Strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language Strong presentation skills. Requires strong negotiation and customer management skills.
    • Problem solving - Strong problem solving skills.
    • Leadership - Ability to work through others to deliver results to the appropriate quality and timeline metrics, monitoring/managing performance and providing feedback, experience productively partnering cross functionally and with customers to advance work effectively and efficiently. Ability to make decisions, bringing clarity to disparate information to inform actions and drive results.
    • Organization - Planning, time management and prioritization skills Ability to organize resources needed to accomplish tasks, set objectives and provide clear direction to others, experience planning activities in advance and taking account of possible changing circumstances.
    • Prioritization - Ability to handle conflicting priorities. Ability to work strategically to realize project goals, identifying and developing positive and compelling visions for the successful delivery of the project.
    • Quality - Attention to detail and accuracy in work.
    • Quality - Results-oriented approach to work delivery and output. Demonstrated learning agility and openness to learning and keeping own knowledge and skill set current and evolving.
    • IT skills - Good software and computer skills, including MS Office applications including but not limited to Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
    • Collaboration - Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with co-workers, managers and clients. Excellent customer service skills and demonstrated ability to understand customer needs. Effective mentoring and training skills, fostering learning and knowledge sharing with colleagues.
    • Cross-collaboration - Ability to work across geographies displaying high awareness and understanding of cultural differences Good understanding of other IQVIA functions and their inter-relationship with Project Leadership.

About Inspectorio

Inspectorio is the leading AI-powered supply chain platform optimizing performance, building resilience, and providing intelligence across production chains for global brands, retailers, and their multi-tier suppliers.

Our innovative platform seamlessly connects and digitizes supply chain processes to optimize decision-making, while providing real-time visibility and control over production chain operations.

Today, Inspectorio is used by over 12,000 customers, including some of the largest brands and retailers in the world.

About the role

The Senior Business Development Manager is responsible for driving top-of-the-funnel growth across the EMEA region. This role focuses on creating, qualifying, and developing new pipeline by engaging enterprise and mid-market brands, retailers, and manufacturers facing increasing quality, product safety, and regulatory complexity.
The role requires strong, ongoing collaboration with Account Executives (AEs) and Marketing, and leverages AI-driven tools and insights to improve prospecting efficiency, targeting, and opportunity quality.

What you'll do

Top-of-the-Funnel Pipeline Generation

  • Proactivelyidentify, research, and qualify prospective customers through outbound prospecting, inbound leads, events, and industry networking.
  • Leverage AI-powered prospecting and data tools toidentifyhigh-intent accounts, prioritize outreach, and personalize engagement at scale.
  • Use market intelligence, regulatory trends, and competitive insights to uncover new early-stage opportunities.
  • Build targeted outreach strategies aligned with regional and industry-specific pain points, including product safety, supplier compliance, audits, recalls, and on-time shipment.

Early-Stage Engagement & Solution Positioning

  • Clearly communicate howInspectorio’ssolutions address customer challenges across quality, compliance, analytics, etc.
  • Align early-stage messaging with Account Executives.

Relationship Building & Stakeholder Mapping

  • Build and nurture early-stage relationships with key decision-makers and influencers.
  • Map accounts andidentifybuying committees.

Market & Industry Expertise

  • Stay informed on industry trends, regulatory requirements, and emerging technologiesimpactingthe EMEA region.

Collaboration with Marketing & Sales

  • Work closely with Marketing to shape top-of-the-funnel campaigns, events, ABM programs, and content for the region.
  • Provide direct feedback to Marketing on lead quality, messaging performance, and regional effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with Account Executives on account planning, opportunity strategy, and early deal shaping to maximize conversion rates.
  • Metrics, Reporting & Performance Track and report top-of-the-funnel KPIs, including meetings booked, qualified opportunities created, pipeline contribution, and regional performance.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Business Development, Sales, or Account Executive roles, with a strong emphasis on top-of-the-funnel pipeline creation, within B2B SaaS, Supply Chain, Quality, Compliance, or related industries.
  • Proven experience generatingpipelineacross international markets.
  • Fluent in English, with French, German, or Italian as a second/third language.
  • Strongqualificationand consultative communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with Account Executives and Marketing teams.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, global, high-growth environment.
  • Experience selling enterprise software related to quality management, inspections, audits, product safety, or regulatory compliance.
  • Familiarity with global supply chains and regulatory frameworks affecting the EMEA region.
  • Experience working with mid-market toenterprise customers.
  • Hands-on experience using HubSpot CRM (preferred).
  • ExperienceleveragingAI tools for prospecting, research, or sales engagement.
  • High levelof ownership, integrity, and accountability.

Benefits

Why it would be awesome to work with us

  • 🍹 Unlimited Annual Leave: We prioritize your well-being and trust you to manage your time.
  • 🏝️ Flexible Working Environment: Whether from home, our global hubs or a coffee shop, work where you're most comfortable.
  • 💪 Project Ownership: You get to lead the initiatives you're passionate about, professionally or socially.
  • 🌱 Grow with us: We're invested in your personal and professional development.
  • 🌎 Global, diverse, and innovative team: Be part of a welcoming community from 30+ countries, where unique perspectives drive innovation.
  • 🤝 Feel at home: Work closely with colleagues who value your voice, share our E.A.C.H. values, and help you be the best version of yourself.
  • 🎉 Celebrate together: Enjoy remote and hub company and team events that strengthen our bonds and build a fun culture.

Our Values

  • EXCELLENCE: We pursue mastery and craftsmanship. "Good enough" is our enemy. We have a thirst and desire for knowledge. There's always an opportunity to be better.
  • AUTONOMY: We act independently when recognizing opportunities for improvement. We seek guidance and clear goals instead of orders. We self-assess the quality and impact of our work.

  • HUMBLENESS: We crave opportunities to learn from the people around us. We leave our egos outside the office. We focus on listening to other perspectives.

raw.description:
AskBio Inc., a wholly owned and independently operated subsidiary of Bayer AG, is a fully integrated gene therapy company dedicated to developing life-saving medicines and changing lives. The company maintains a portfolio of clinical programs across a range of neuromuscular, central nervous system, cardiovascular, and metabolic disease indications with a clinical-stage pipeline that includes investigational therapeutics for congestive heart failure, limb-girdle muscular dystrophy, multiple system atrophy, Parkinson’s disease, and Pompe disease. AskBio’s gene therapy platform includes Pro10™, an industry-leading proprietary cell line manufacturing process, and an extensive array of capsids and promoters. With global headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, and European headquarters in Edinburgh, Scotland, the company has generated hundreds of proprietary capsids and promoters, several of which have entered pre-clinical and clinical testing.

Our vision: Pioneering science to create transformative molecular medicines.

Our mission: Lead innovative science and drive clinical outcomes to transform people's lives.

Our principles:

  • Advance innovative science by pushing boundaries.

  • Bring transformative therapeutics to patients in need.

  • Provide an environment for employees to reach their fullest potential.

Our values:

  • Be a Pioneer. We are not afraid of the impossible and to innovate to make gene therapies accessible to those in need.

  • Cultivate Collaboration. Strive to be the best teammate, actively listen, openly communicate, and embrace diverse points of view.

  • Embrace Responsibility. We are humbled by the enormity of our mission. We hold a relentless commitment to advance science and clinical outcomes for our patients, families, and caregivers.

  • Raise the Bar. Continuously drive improvements and efficiencies. Seek and provide constructive feedback. Have a bias for learning and action.

  • Act with Uncompromising Integrity. Be honest, transparent, and committed to doing what’s right in every situation. Make clear commitments and follow through.

Position Summary

The Director, Regulatory Affairs will serve as a U.S.-based regulatory strategy lead for assigned development programs, with responsibility for driving global regulatory strategy and providing focused leadership for regulatory activities. This role will provide regulatory direction for preclinical and clinical development of AskBio’s product candidates, working closely with cross-functional Regulatory team members, Global Project Teams, subject matter experts, and external partners to ensure regulatory strategies are aligned with applicable health authority requirements and expectations.

This position will support and/or lead interactions with global health authorities, including EMA and other European and ROW agencies, and will contribute to high-quality, timely regulatory submissions, agency meeting packages, regulatory designations, and development-stage submissions.

The role will report into Regulatory Affairs and work remotely from within the United States.

Job Responsibilities

  • Serve as Regulatory Affairs lead or representative for assigned programs, providing strategic regulatory guidance and interpretation to support product development in alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and health authority expectations

  • Develop and execute innovative, integrated regulatory strategies and timelines for assigned programs, including strategies that support global development and European regulatory objectives

  • Lead or support preparation and submission of regulatory documents for clinical development programs, including CTAs, amendments, scientific advice briefing packages, regulatory designations, and future marketing application activities, as applicable

  • Lead regulatory document review, comment resolution, and approval processes to ensure documents are high quality, scientifically sound, submission-ready, and aligned with regulatory strategy

Recruiting agencies: Proper Voltage does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions. Please do not contact any employees directly unless you have an existing engagement with the company.

About Proper Voltage

Proper Voltage is unlocking the next generation of battery technology across robotics, data centers, and defense.

We're building intelligent battery systems that make advanced chemistries (sodium-ion, lithium-titanate, lithium-silicon) work in products that were never designed for them. Humanoid robots can upgrade power systems without redesigning their entire platform. Data centers get safer, cheaper backup power. Drones and autonomous vehicles get higher energy density without lengthy integration cycles.

If you want to work on hard engineering problems that matter this is the place.

Job Overview

The Director of Logistics owns Proper Voltage's end-to-end freight and logistics function: inbound material flow, outbound customer delivery, packaging design and validation, and reverse logistics. Our finished product is a large-format battery system, classified as a dangerous good, shipped to commercial and defense customers who expect flawless delivery from day one.

This role reports to the VP of Supply Chain and works closely with the Director of Supply Chain (contract manufacturer and procurement relationships), the Materials Program Manager (who will report to this role), engineering, and our customers' receiving and logistics teams.

This is a build-from-scratch role. Outbound shipping for a large dangerous-goods product has real safety, regulatory, and customer-relationship stakes that a generalist logistics function cannot absorb as a side responsibility. You will set up the carrier relationships, the packaging program, and the customer delivery process before our first commercial shipments, and you will own the freight strategy across both inbound and outbound as we scale.

Scope

  • Inbound: you own freight forwarder relationships and inbound freight strategy across our supplier base, including Asia-origin suppliers. When a supplier quotes ex-works or FOB origin, you decide how that material moves from the supplier's dock to our contract manufacturers, and you negotiate the rates and service levels that get it there reliably and cost-effectively.
  • Outbound: you own dangerous-goods-compliant shipping to commercial and defense customers. This includes carrier qualification, hazmat documentation and labeling, driver certification requirements, and the customer-facing delivery experience. Our product ships in both individual units (in the low hundreds of pounds) and larger rack configurations (over a thousand pounds), so packaging and handling requirements span a wide range.
  • Packaging: our contract manufacturers support packaging execution, and we expect to bring in specialized packaging engineering support as needed. You will own the coordination and final validation (drop testing sign-off, handling instructions, ensuring the packaging solution meets DG and customer requirements) without needing to be the hands-on packaging designer.
  • Reverse logistics: you build the process for defective unit returns, including dangerous-goods-compliant return shipping, customer coordination, and field service logistics support.
  • This role starts as an individual contributor with the Materials Program Manager reporting to you. The team will grow as volume and complexity increase.

Who this role is for

  • You have real experience shipping a regulated, hazardous, or safety-critical product at commercial scale. You know how dangerous goods classification, carrier certification, and hazmat documentation actually work in practice, not just in theory.
  • You have built or significantly scaled a logistics function from an early stage. You've negotiated freight forwarder contracts, qualified carriers, and set up a customer delivery process where none existed before.
  • You think about total landed cost, not just freight rate. You know when using your own forwarder instead of a supplier's preferred logistics provider saves real money and improves visibility, and you know how to make that case and execute on it.
  • You are comfortable owning both inbound and outbound freight as one connected function, and you understand where that overlaps with (and stays distinct from) supplier commercial negotiation.
  • You are comfortable in early-stage environments where the playbook is still being written. You will build the carrier relationships, packaging program, and delivery process from the ground up.

This role is not a fit if

  • Your logistics experience is limited to standard, non-hazardous freight.
  • You need an established freight and carrier network in place before you can be effective. You will build this.
  • You are looking for a role focused only on strategy without hands-on operational ownership. This role is deeply hands-on in the near term.
  • You would find a startup operating tempo frustrating.

What you'll do

Inbound logistics

  • Establish and manage freight forwarder relationships across our supplier base, with particular focus on Asia-origin freight.
  • Negotiate freight rates and service levels. Identify opportunities to shift from supplier-managed freight to our own forwarder relationships when it reduces cost or improves visibility.
  • Own cargo visibility and tracking for critical inbound shipments, in partnership with the Materials Program Manager.
  • Coordinate customs clearance and import compliance with brokers and internal partners.

Outbound logistics

  • Qualify and manage dangerous-goods-certified carriers for outbound shipments to commercial and defense customers.
  • Own hazmat shipping documentation, labeling, and driver certification requirements. Ensure every outbound shipment is fully compliant.
  • Build and own the customer delivery experience, including scheduling, communication, and issue resolution.
  • Investigate and resolve quality issues arising in transit (damage, handling, documentation errors).

Packaging

  • Partner with our contract manufacturers and, as needed, outside packaging engineering resources on packaging design for individual unit and multi-unit rack shipments. Own final validation: drop testing sign-off and handling instructions.
  • Coordinate packaging vendor relationships for custom crating, palletization, and protective packaging as needed. Deep hands-on packaging design experience is a plus, not a requirement; support resources are available.

Reverse logistics

  • Build the RMA and defective unit return process, including dangerous-goods-compliant return shipping.
  • Coordinate field service and pickup logistics with customers.

Team and cross-functional leadership

  • Manage the Materials Program Manager and align inbound freight strategy with material readiness needs.
  • Execute freight strategy within terms set by Director of Supply Chain as part of supplier commercial strategy
  • Partner with engineering, finance, and customer-facing teams on delivery commitments and cost.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years in logistics, transportation, or supply chain operations, including direct ownership of dangerous goods or other regulated product shipping.
  • Direct experience with hazmat/DG shipping compliance: carrier certification, documentation, labeling, and driver requirements.
  • Experience negotiating freight forwarder contracts and managing an international freight network, including Asia-origin lanes.
  • Experience building or significantly scaling a logistics function, including customer delivery processes, from an early stage.
  • Direct people management experience.
  • Ability to operate independently and build process where none exists yet.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience shipping industrial batteries or other energy storage products.
  • Experience with packaging design and validation for heavy or large-format products.
  • Experience serving defense or government customers with specific delivery and compliance requirements.
  • Experience with reverse logistics and field service coordination.
  • Early-stage startup experience building logistics functions from zero.
  • Familiarity with customs brokerage and cross-border trade compliance.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary of $200,000 to $220,000, plus equity.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Flexible PTO with a generous holiday policy.
  • Carlsbad, CA or near our contract manufacturers preferred. Open to fully virtual for the right candidate. Regular travel to our contract manufacturers, vendors, and occasional customer site visits.

  • Sólida experiência com Flutter e Dart em produção, incluindo apps publicados nas lojas (App Store e Google Play) com escala relevante de usuários;

  • Experiência com CI/CD para mobile (Fastlane, Codemagic, Bitrise ou similares), versionamento e processos de release nas lojas.
  • Desejável conhecimento nativo em Android (Kotlin) e/ou iOS (Swift) para debugar integrações de plugins e canais nativos;
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis, com capacidade de equilibrar decisões técnicas com prazos e prioridades de negócio.
  • Boa comunicação para transitar entre discussões técnicas profundas e conversas com stakeholders não técnicos.
