raw.description:
N3XT is a Wyoming-chartered Special Purpose Depository Institution (SPDI). We are a 100% reserved, non-lending bank designed to serve as a secure bridge between traditional capital markets and public blockchain infrastructure. Backed by Paradigm, HACK VC, Winklevoss Capital, and Pharsalus, we prioritize safety and transparency for institutional B2B clients.

Company: N3XT

Location: NYC Preferred (Flexible / Remote)

Job Type: Full-Time

How the Banking World is Changing

The global banking architecture is undergoing a foundational paradigm shift. Traditional fractional-reserve banking systems and legacy settlement networks are increasingly constrained by T+1/T+2 settlement delays, operational counterparty risk, restricted operating hours, and fragmented capital efficiency. As institutional finance converges with public blockchain infrastructure, capital markets demand programmatic, 24/7/365 settlement rails backed by total transparency and unencumbered reserves. Operating under a Wyoming Special Purpose Depository Institution Charter, N3XT represents the next evolution of narrow banking—providing a fully-reserved, institutional-grade bridge between traditional capital markets and digital asset liquidity.

About N3XT

N3XT is a Wyoming-chartered Special Purpose Depository Institution (SPDI). We are a new, innovative bank designed to serve as the premier settlement and banking infrastructure bridging traditional capital markets and public blockchain rails. Backed by elite institutional investors including Paradigm, HACK VC, Winklevoss Capital, and Pharsalus, we provide institutional-grade security, execution velocity, and total transparency for global B2B clients, trading desks, and market makers operating in a globally connected world.

About the Role

Growth at N3XT is driven by market structure design, deep network effects, and high-value institutional execution. The Commercial team is responsible for introducing narrow banking and frictionless fiat-to-digital settlement to the world’s most sophisticated capital markets participants.

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Business Development Manager with a proven track record in institutional capital markets, trading infrastructure, or institutional sales to architect and drive our expansion across premier global financial hubs.

Reporting directly to the Head of Commercial & Growth, you will lead high-stakes deal origination and strategic coverage. You will operate at the intersection of US banking rails, institutional liquidity flows, and digital asset markets—engaging CFOs, Treasurers, Chief Investment Officers, and Heads of Trading to position N3XT as the primary banking and settlement partner for institutional capital.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Institutional Origination & Deal Structuring: Lead end-to-end deal cycles with tier-1 and mid-tier institutional market participants, including market makers, quantitative funds, OTC desks, prime brokers, and high-volume institutional liquidity providers.
  • C-Suite Advisory & Treasury Solutions: Partner with client CFOs, Treasurers, and Heads of Trading to architect bespoke banking setups that optimize pre-funding requirements, accelerate fiat-crypto settlement cycles, and maximize collateral liquidity management.
  • Capital Markets Flywheel & Ecosystem Expansion: Scale N3XT’s institutional referral ecosystem ("Meet me @ N3XT"), embedding our banking infrastructure into prime brokerage, custody, and trading counterparty networks to drive exponential network effects.
  • Strategic Event & Industry Representation: Represent N3XT as a subject matter expert at premier global conferences (Capital Markets, FX, and Digital Asset summits)—driving C-level bilateral meetings, keynotes, and rapid client onboarding.
  • Commercial Strategy & Pipeline Governance: Own revenue, deposit, and transaction volume KPIs. Utilize pipeline analytics and market feedback to inform executive leadership on product roadmap priorities and strategic market positioning.

What You’ll Need

  • 5–8+ years of commercial experience in Capital Markets BD/Sales, Prime Brokerage, FX/OTC Trading, or Institutional Digital Asset Sales.
  • Institutional Capital Markets Expertise: Deep understanding of market structure, clearance and settlement mechanics, trade workflows, liquidity management, and prime brokerage dynamics.
  • Digital Asset & Crypto Fluency: Sophisticated understanding of institutional digital asset infrastructure—specifically stablecoin rails, fiat-crypto ramp mechanics, CeFi liquidity desks, and emerging tokenized asset workflows.
  • Proven Track Record of Deal Origination: Demonstrated history of independently prospecting, structuring, and closing complex, high-value institutional financial services accounts.
  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Ability to map complex market ecosystems, navigate multi-stakeholder approval processes, and utilize data-driven insights to refine target account-based strategies.

Nice to Have

  • An established network of C-level decision-makers across Wall Street, Tier-1 trading desks, market makers, exchanges, and institutional fintechs.
  • Direct experience navigating institutional onboarding, complex KYB/AML requirements, and multi-jurisdictional banking regulations.
  • Experience executing "land and expand" programs or account-based marketing (ABM) targeting high-net-volume accounts.

Core Values: Who We Are

  • Get It Done: We deliver on our commitments, meet deadlines, and take complete accountability to achieve our goals.
  • Never Settle: We pursue excellence through continuous improvement, constantly elevating client experience, security, and personal growth.
  • Integrity Over Ease: We operate with radical transparency, honesty, and respect—doing what is right for our clients, team, and stakeholders, even when it is hard.

General Description:

The Manager, Global ICSR Management oversees triage, case processing and in-line quality control focusing on efficiency, quality & compliance. The Manager, in consultation with the Process Excellence team, is responsible for monitoring, defining, and setting metrics and determining course of action to resolve any issues. The Manager has decision-making authority to clarify ICSR issues related to governance documents rising from the ICSR team. The Manager will also represent GPS Safety Operations in cross functional projects related to ICSR activities, as needed. The Manager will provide support, as needed, in audits and inspections.

Essential Functions:

ICSR Case Management activities

Monitor the activities of triage, case processing, and quality control of individual case safety reports (ICSR) to ensure timely completion of activities and assist with execution of activities if needed.

SAE Reconciliation

  • Support and assist with SAE reconciliation between safety and clinical databases.
  • Track SAE reconciliation to ensure completion and adherence to internal and external timelines and resolve or escalate issues with SAE reconciliation.
  • Review SAE reconciliation plan.

Quality and Compliance Indicators

Productivity and Process Excellence

Workflow Management:

Audit & Inspection Support

  • Act as SME in audits and inspections with support from senior manager.
  • Execute audit/inspection readiness activities.

Vendor/CRO Management

  • Communicate signed PV Agreement/Contract information to team.

Cross-Functional Collaborations & Ad-hoc Requests

  • Lead critical process or sub-process areas and project initiatives within GPS organization
  • May lead and/or participate as ICSR Management subject matter expert (SME) on cross functional projects (outside the GPS) organization as needed.

Training & Onboarding

  • Deliver training to new team members.
  • Develop and update training materials.
  • Provide feedback to line manager for review about new team member onboarding status.
  • Support resolving issues or escalate to line manager for new team members.

Study configuration testing

  • Execute Study configuration testing in safety database, as needed.

Minimum Requirements – Education and Experience:

Minimum bachelor’s degree (major in life sciences, clinical medicine, nursing, pharmacy) or other health care professional or the equivalent combination of relevant education or professional experience. Advanced degree preferred.

Other Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in drug safety/pharmacovigilance or relevant clinical experience, including training required.
  • Strong understanding of Global regulatory requirements (i.e. ICH, GVP, FDA 21CFR 312.32, 314.80, GCP, NMPA Announcement (No. 66, 2018), PAL of PRC (Dec 2019)) for capture and submissions of pharmacovigilance individual case safety reports and aggregate safety reports to FDA, CDE/NMPA, EMA, MHRA, and other global regulatory authorities/national competent authorities.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Travel: 5%

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit .

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE JOB

The CRM Marketing Manager is responsible for executing lifecycle strategy across venue email and SMS programs. Reporting to the Head of Lifecycle Marketing, this role manages newsletters, post-purchase journeys, fan education campaigns, and support for vertical marketing initiatives.

This position focuses exclusively on venue lifecycle communications and ensures campaigns are personalized, timely, and aligned with operations, venue brand fulfillment and revenue-driving priorities.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Build and manage venue newsletters and automated email journeys.
  • Develop post-purchase communications designed to drive ancillary sales and upsell opportunities.
  • Support vertical marketing initiatives across Premium, B2C, and F&B programs.
  • Implement segmentation strategies to improve engagement and conversion.
  • Monitor and optimize performance across key lifecycle metrics.
  • Maintain QA standards and data accuracy across campaigns.
  • Collaborate with Brand and Social teams to ensure cross-channel alignment.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 4–6 years of experience in email marketing, CRM, or lifecycle marketing.
  • Experience with marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  • Excellent written communication skills.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. HIRING PRACTICES
The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. Job Description

UPLIZNA gMG Medical Marketing, Manager

Amgen, one of the world's leading biotechnology companies, is a values-based company deeply rooted in science and innovation to transform new ideas and discoveries into medicines for patients with serious illnesses. If you're seeking a career where you can truly make a difference in the lives of others—working at the forefront of biotechnology alongside some of the industry's brightest minds—you'll find it at Amgen.

Join one of Amgen's most exciting growth brands. UPLIZNA has established strong early growth following its launch in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), while maintaining strong momentum in neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD), creating an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative, high-performing team focused on driving continued commercial success and improving outcomes for patients living with two rare autoimmune diseases – gMG & NMOSD.

The UPLIZNA Neurology Medical Marketing Manager will play a critical role in accelerating adoption of UPLIZNA by leading strategic healthcare professional (HCP) marketing initiatives that educate customers, strengthen brand differentiation, and support best-in-class field execution. Working across a highly matrixed organization, this individual will partner with Sales, Medical, Regulatory, Legal, Market Access, Global Marketing, Market Research, and other cross-functional teams to deliver innovative marketing strategies and promotional resources that position UPLIZNA for sustained growth.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Neurology P2P Medical Marketing, the Manager will support franchise peer-to-peer (P2P) execution across both indications -gMG & NMOSD- and co-lead the U.S. Neurology congress planning and execution portfolio. This role requires strong cross-functional collaboration, strategic thinking, disciplined project management, and high-quality execution. Working across a highly matrixed organization, this individual will partner with Thought Lead Liaisons (TLLs), Sales, Medical, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, Global Marketing, Market Research, and other cross-functional teams to deliver innovative P2P & congress strategy & execution that position UPLIZNA for sustained growth in the neurology space.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with the Senior Manager, Neurology Medical Marketing to translate the franchise P2P strategy into high-quality execution across NMOSD and gMG.
  • Lead assigned P2P workstreams end-to-end, including speaker bureau operations, speaker recruitment and onboarding, speaker training, symposia, product theaters, field-facing resources, and/or other peer-to-peer programs.
  • Lead development and lifecycle management of assigned branded and disease-state P2P materials, including speaker decks and program resources; manage agency development, internal Medical, Legal and Regulatory review, approval, rollout, and ongoing updates.
  • Support ongoing optimization of the Neurology speaker bureau and P2P programs by monitoring execution, gathering field and customer feedback, and identifying opportunities to improve program quality and impact.
  • Co-lead annual U.S. Neurology congress planning with medical marketing leadership and a peer Medical Marketing Manager, including meeting prioritization, portfolio allocation, objectives, budgets, activation plans, and measures of success.
  • Own end-to-end strategy and execution for assigned congresses, including cross-functional planning, sponsorships, meeting and event space, product theaters, agency and vendor management, internal readiness, on-site execution, and post-congress follow-up.
  • Partner with Professional Marketing and agency teams on booth strategy, content, design, and execution for assigned congresses, ensuring alignment with franchise objectives and the broader congress plan.
  • Support in the development of KOL engagement plans around assigned congresses in partnership with field colleagues; support relationships with relevant professional societies, congress organizers, and external experts.
  • Lead pre- and post-congress alignment with Medical Affairs, TLLs, Marketing, Sales, Market Research, Global, and other partners; establish clear roles, timelines, deliverables, and follow-up actions.
  • Collaborate with the Neurology Insights team to incorporate customer insights and emerging needs into P2P and congress plans.
  • Contribute to annual brand planning and lead assigned medical marketing tactical plans, budgets, and performance monitoring.
  • Maintain an in-depth understanding of competitive activity, evolving treatment dynamics, customer needs, and congress trends across NMOSD and gMG; translate relevant developments into clear recommendations.
  • Manage multiple agencies and external vendors, ensuring high-quality delivery on time and within budget.
  • Effectively collaborate with and influence cross-functional teams, including Global Marketing, Legal, Regulatory, Medical Affairs, Compliance, Professional Marketing, Patient Marketing, TLLs, Advocacy, Market Research, Market Access, Sales Operations, Sales Training, and field leadership.
  • Live and role model Amgen Values and contribute to a welcoming, engaging, and high-performing environment within the UPLIZNA brand team and across cross-functional partners.

Win

What we expect of you

Basic Qualifications

Doctorate degree

OR

Master's degree and 2 years of Marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization

OR

Bachelor's degree and 4 years of Marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization

OR

Associate's degree and 8 years of Marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization

OR

High school diploma / GED and 10 years of Marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • Strong medical marketing competencies, including P2P strategy and execution, speaker bureau operations, speaker training, promotional content development, KOL engagement, congress planning, and multichannel engagement.
  • Experience leading or supporting P2P programs, including speaker bureau operations, speaker materials, speaker training, and product theaters.
  • Experience owning congress activities end-to-end, including sponsorship planning, cross-functional coordination, external vendor management, budget oversight, and on-site execution.
  • Experience developing promotional and disease-state materials and guiding content through the MAC review process and associated systems, such as Veeva PromoMats.
  • Experience collaborating with external experts and professional medical associations.
  • Experience in neurology preferred; rare disease and launch or in-line brand experience preferred.
  • Strong strategic thinking and project management skills, with the ability to balance multiple complex priorities and external vendors.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and collaborate effectively across functions and levels, including senior management and field organizations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex information and strategies into clear, actionable, and impactful plans.

Thrive

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, so we work to care for our teammates' professional and personal growth and well-being.

Clear and disciplined strategic vision for the future that leverages superior-quality products, operational excellence and top-shelf-talent.

Diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where teammates are empowered to bring ideas to the table and act.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan comprising health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities including:

  • Comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts.

  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan

  • Stock-based long-term incentives

  • Award-winning time-off plans

  • Flexible work models, including remote work arrangements, where possible

Apply now

for a career that defies imagination

Objects in your future are closer than they appear. Join us.

The Kayne Anderson Rudnick Lead Advisor (“LA”) will partner with the Managing Director, Business Development Officer (“BDO”) in their respective market in the development and management of clients, many of whom are referred via custodial referral programs. The LA will develop a plan to meet the client’s goals and manage all aspects of these new client relationships including investment advisory, financial planning, and estate and tax planning.

  • Conduct regular client portfolio review meetings and provide proactive communication to clients.

  • 5+ years of experience in the financial services industry with a focus on wealth advisory client service.

raw.title: OT Security Penetration Tester (Texas/Florida)
raw.excerpt: Packetlabs is a cybersecurity consulting firm specializing in advanced Penetration Testing.
raw.description:
Packetlabs is a cybersecurity consulting firm specializing in advanced Penetration Testing. We exist to eliminate the false sense of security that comes from shallow testing and checkbox-driven assessments. Our slogan, "Ready for more than a VA scan?", reflects a simple standard: real security work should be rigorous, manual, and built to uncover what automated approaches miss. Our clients span government, technology, law enforcement, retail, healthcare, and financial services, and they rely on us because credibility matters when the stakes are high.

Packetlabs is looking for an OT Security Consultant to own how Packetlabs evaluates risk in sensitive, high-stakes systems where uptime, safety, and reliability cannot be compromised. The OT Security Consultant is a specialized technical role focused on assessing Operational Technology (OT) environments across all industries. This role is about applying deep security judgment to environments where conventional testing approaches are too blunt, and where credibility comes from knowing when to push and when to hold back.

This role requires the rare combination of offensive security instinct and operational restraint. OT environments (industrial control systems, SCADA, and field devices) demand a consultant who can identify real risk without introducing it. You will work directly with clients to understand their environments and deliver findings that improve security posture without disrupting operations. At Packetlabs, you’ll be backed by a team that is deeply committed to technical excellence. We hold ourselves to a high standard, invest heavily in our team, and give our experts the autonomy and support needed to become leaders in their field.

What you’ll be doing

  • Security Architecture Reviews
    • Perform holistic tabletop reviews covering both technical and non-technical risk across OT environments, without engaging in high-risk manual or automated activity
    • Analyze for areas of negative impact, high risk, and single points of failure (SPOF) within sensitive, legacy networks
    • Apply structured judgment to identify where risk is concentrated and where controls are missing
    • Adapt review depth and approach to the operational realities of each client environment
  • OT Risk Identification & Assessment
    • Identify vulnerabilities and weaknesses across Operational Technology environments, including Industrial Control Systems (ICS), SCADA, and field devices
    • Assess legacy and sensitive networks where conventional testing methods carry unacceptable operational risk
    • Distinguish between theoretical and operationally relevant risk to keep findings actionable
    • Prove impact where appropriate, exercising restraint where the environment demands it
  • Client Advisory & Program Improvement
    • Support OT clients with security program improvements, identifying which critical controls are needed
    • Refine testing scope collaboratively as engagements proceed and the environment becomes clearer
    • Translate technical findings into guidance that clients can act on across both technical and leadership audiences
    • Build client confidence through credibility, clear communication, and operational awareness
  • Methodology & Continuous Improvement
    • Contribute to the maturity of Packetlabs' OT testing methodology and practice
    • Stay current on OT threats, attack techniques, and defensive controls
    • Share knowledge with the broader team to minimize blind spots and strengthen collective capability
    • Help raise the standard of OT security work across the firm

Who you are

  • No egos, ever. Egos don't belong at Packetlabs. The more you learn, the less you know. You stay humble, ask questions, and work to help clients improve their security.
  • Customer-first mentality. You are an excellent communicator with clients, project managers, and teammates. You are responsive, reliable, and professional throughout every engagement.
  • You deliver work that you take pride in. Your work is an autograph of your excellence. You hold yourself to a high standard and it shows in what you produce.
  • Digs deeper into every finding. You don't stop until impact is proven, while understanding that restraint is the right call in sensitive OT environments where high-risk activity is not appropriate.
  • Comfortable being uncomfortable. You move toward obstacles, not away from them. Consulting is not a typical job and requires adapting to rapidly changing environments.
  • Always learning. Cybersecurity changes every day and you keep up because you want to. You are deeply aware of your skillset and committed to improving it.
  • Self-motivated and dependable. You take ownership of your work and your outcomes without needing to be managed into them.
  • You must be located in Texas or Florida.

What you bring

  • A graduate of an Information Security or Computer Science degree program
  • Professional qualifications (one or more preferred): GICSP, GRID, GCIP, CSSA, CACE, CISSP, OSCP
  • 3+ years experience assessing or operating within OT, ICS, or SCADA environments
  • Strong understanding of the operational constraints that make OT testing distinct from IT testing
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey risk clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • A demonstrated commitment to continuous learning in a rapidly evolving field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in unfamiliar or highly specialized environments

What success looks like

  • Clients gain a clear, accurate understanding of their OT risk without any operational disruption
  • Findings are credible, impactful, and directly actionable for both technical and leadership audiences
  • Engagements are delivered to a consistently high standard with strong client confidence
  • Scope is managed well as engagements evolve, with risk surfaced early and clearly
  • Packetlabs' OT methodology and practice continue to mature through your contribution
  • Clients trust Packetlabs as a partner that understands the stakes of testing sensitive environments

Why us?

  • The opportunity to work on high-stakes OT engagements where your judgment genuinely matters
  • Receive immediate and ongoing offensive security training, mentorship, and professional development to advance your technical capabilities
  • Play a key role in shaping the growth, direction, and methodology of Packetlabs expanding OT practice
  • A leadership team that values substance, quality, and disciplined execution
  • Collaboration with a highly skilled team of security professionals who are passionate about technical excellence and raising the bar
  • Competitive compensation and growth opportunity
  • GRRSP with corporate matching in Canada
  • Participation in corporate benefit plans within Canada
  • Flexible work environment that empowers employees to do their best work
  • Fully remote within Texas or Florida

raw.description:
You will serve as an AI Content Producer for Etaily Brand Labs, supporting the content production needs of its in-house brand portfolio, including Nutrie, Fizzko, Revibe, InGlow, AllNite, and Best Mama. Your role is to produce high-quality, on-brand creative assets across wellness, beauty, lifestyle, maternal care, and adult wellness categories.

You will use Higgsfield as the primary AI production platform to create short-form videos, static assets, product-led content, motion creatives, social content, and campaign materials at speed and scale.
You will work closely with the Brand Building team to translate briefs into platform-ready content for TikTok, Meta, Lazada, Shopee, TikTok Shop, affiliate channels, and other digital touchpoints.

Scope of Work
  • You will produce AI-assisted creative assets using Higgsfield, including short-form videos, social content, product explainers, performance creatives, static assets, and motion-led campaign materials.
  • You will develop reusable Higgsfield-based workflows for image generation, video generation, image-to-video execution, prompt systems, product consistency, editing, and creative variations.
  • You will translate brand positioning, campaign objectives, and product priorities into clear, effective, and platform-ready creative outputs.
  • You will create content variations for testing across paid media, organic social, marketplace, affiliate, and brand channels.
  • You will ensure that all final assets are on-brand, accurate, properly formatted, and ready for publishing or media deployment.
  • You will organize prompts, working files, exports, and production references for efficient team handoff and future reuse.
Expected Capability
You are expected to have strong capability or working knowledge in AI-assisted content creation, generative content production, and short-form video development, with Higgsfield as the main production platform.
You are also expected to demonstrate strong visual judgment, storytelling ability, platform-native content understanding, and the ability to work across multiple brands with distinct audiences, tones, and visual identities.

Success in the Role
Success in this role means helping Etaily Brand Labs build a scalable Higgsfield-led AI content production workflow that allows the team to create high-quality, strategic, and platform-ready content faster, while maintaining brand consistency and creative effectiveness.

Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Summary of Position

In your role as a Growth Marketing Manager, you will own growth initiatives that drive consumer acquisition and enrollment across Teladoc Health's Chronic Condition Management (CCM) business while leading conversion rate optimization efforts across both CCM and Telehealth digital experiences.

This role sits at the intersection of growth marketing, experimentation, analytics, and digital optimization. You will develop and execute high-impact enrollment email, direct mail, SMS and OBTM campaigns, lead landing page testing programs, improve website performance through SEO/AEO/GEO strategies, and partner with teams across Product, Data Science, Creative, Marketing Operations, Marketing Automation, Paid Media, Behavioral Science and Analytics to drive measurable business impact.

You will combine strong analytical thinking with customer-centric problem solving to identify growth opportunities, design experiments, uncover insights, and scale winning strategies.

Success in this role requires a bias toward action, intellectual curiosity, strong communication skills, and the ability to independently own initiatives from strategy through execution and measurement.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Acquisition Strategy & Campaign Leadership

  • Own the strategy, execution, and performance of CCM incremental acquisition campaigns across email, direct mail, SMS, OBTM, and other emerging channels
  • Develop audience, messaging, creative, and channel strategies that drive incremental enrollments and measurable business impact
  • Lead campaign planning, requirements gathering, stakeholder alignment, launch execution, and post-campaign performance analysis
  • Identify and validate new growth opportunities through pilot programs, experimentation, and continuous optimization
  • Partner with Data Science, Business Analytics, Marketing Automation, and Marketing Operations teams to measure incrementality, improve campaign performance, and strengthen marketing measurement capabilities

Conversion Rate Optimization & Experimentation

  • Own the CRO roadmap across CCM and Telehealth enrollment experiences, with accountability for improving conversion performance and reducing enrollment friction.
  • Build and manage a testing roadmap leveraging behavioral science principles, customer insights, and business priorities.
  • Design, launch, analyze, and scale A/B and multivariate tests using VWO and other experimentation platforms.
  • Leverage Amplitude and other analytics tools to identify opportunities throughout the enrollment funnel and prioritize high-impact optimizations.
  • Improve landing page discoverability and performance through SEO, AEO, GEO, schema, content, and user experience enhancements

Qualifications Expected for Position

  • 5+ years of experience in Growth Marketing, Digital Marketing, Performance Marketing, CRO, or related disciplines.
  • Proven track record driving measurable customer acquisition and conversion growth.
  • Experience developing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns including email, direct mail, and digital channels.
  • Strong experimentation experience including A/B testing, multivariate testing, and incrementality methodologies.
  • Experience leveraging analytics platforms to generate insights and guide decision making.
  • Strong project management and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

Preferred

  • Experience with Amplitude, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, or similar analytics platforms
  • Experience using VWO, Optimizely, Adobe Target, or similar experimentation platforms
  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC)
  • Experience with SEO, AEO, GEO, schema implementation, and AI-driven search optimization strategies
  • Experience working in healthcare, health technology, or highly regulated industries
  • Familiarity with behavioral science principles and customer decision-making frameworks
  • Experience partnering with Data Science and Product teams to drive growth initiatives

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

The base salary range for this position is $80,000 - $90,000. In addition to a base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and benefits (subject to eligibility requirements) listed here: Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. Total compensation is based on several factors including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable for all full-time positions.

We follow a Flexible Vacation Policy, intended for rest, relaxation, and personal time. All time off must be approved by your manager prior to use. You will also receive 80 hours of Paid Sick, Safe, and Caregiver Leave annually. This applies to full-time positions only. If you are applying for a part-time role, your recruiter can provide additional details.

As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified.

Teladoc Health will not sponsor or transfer employment work visas for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Why join Teladoc Health?

  • Teladoc Health is transforming how better health happens. Learn how when you join us in pursuit of our impactful mission.

  • Chart your career path with meaningful opportunities that empower you to grow, lead, and make a difference.

  • Join a multi-faceted community that celebrates each colleague’s unique perspective and is focused on continually improving, each and every day.

  • Contribute to an innovative culture where fresh ideas are valued as we increase access to care in new ways.

  • Enjoy an inclusive benefits program centered around you and your family, with tailored programs that address your unique needs.

  • Explore candidate resources with tips and tricks from Teladoc Health recruiters and learn more about our company culture by exploring #TeamTeladocHealth on LinkedIn.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, religion, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, membership in an employee organization, medical condition, family history, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, parental status, or pregnancy). In our innovative and inclusive workplace, we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind.

Teladoc Health respects your privacy and is committed to maintaining the confidentiality and security of your personal information. In furtherance of your employment relationship with Teladoc Health, we collect personal information responsibly and in accordance with applicable data privacy laws, including but not limited to, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Personal information is defined as: Any information or set of information relating to you, including (a) all information that identifies you or could reasonably be used to identify you, and (b) all information that any applicable law treats as personal information. raw.description:
Join the Team Modernizing Medicine

At ModMed, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: we hired doctors and taught them how to code. This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI-enabled, specialty-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

A Culture of Excellence

When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500+ passionate problem-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

  • Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work

  • 2025 Globee Business Awards: Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”

  • 2025 Black Book Awards: Ranked #1 EHR in 11 Specialties

  • Florida Venture Forum: Venture-Backed Company of the Year

We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.

Ready to modernize medicine with us?

Job Description Summary:

ModMed is hiring two Demand Generation Specialists to join our full-funnel marketing engine, with each role focusing on a distinct and critical segment of our market. Whether you thrive in a high-volume, fast-paced environment or enjoy navigating the strategic complexities of larger, multi-location accounts, we have a path for you. One specialist will support our Key Segment (1–3 providers), delivering campaigns focused on immediate ROI, time-savings, and cost efficiencies for doctor-owners operating with lean budgets. The second specialist will focus on our Strategic Segment (4–19 providers), building tailored campaigns that solve for multi-site optimization, total cost of ownership (TCO), and board-level considerations. If you are a proactive learner who loves working with data and processes, this is your chance to make a measurable impact.

Your role

  • Partner closely with the Demand Generation Manager to coordinate multi-channel campaigns, ensuring all digital assets (emails, landing pages, and ads) are synchronized and ready for launch.

  • Depending on your assigned segment, you will either develop strategies that prioritize task automation for resource-constrained small practices (Key Segment) or address more complex objectives like multi-site optimization, TCO, and staff retention (Strategic Segment).

  • Assist in driving project timelines and keeping cross-functional teams like Creative, Operations, and Content perfectly aligned on upcoming deliverables.

  • Own the day-to-day tracking of marketing campaign performance metrics across the entire demand generation funnel, including MQLs, SALs, SQLs, and Pipeline.

  • Compile weekly and monthly performance reports, identifying key trends and providing initial observations to help optimize our marketing spend.

  • Maintain excellent data hygiene within our CRM and marketing automation platforms to guarantee reporting accuracy.

  • Support overall budget tracking and vendor management tasks while organizing internal documentation, campaign calendars, and creative brief repositories.

  • Schedule and prepare for weekly segment meetings, which includes collaborative agenda setting and capturing actionable next steps.

  • Attend strategic meetings for both segments and act as a central liaison between the Demand Gen and Sales Development teams to keep lead follow-up processes running seamlessly.

  • Stay updated on ModMed’s evolving product offerings to effectively articulate how our technology solves specific buyer pain points—whether providing "time-back" solutions for independent doctors or driving efficiency and positive staff environments for multi-site groups.

Skills & requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in a marketing or similar role.

  • Required familiarity with Excel or Google Sheets; prior exposure to Salesforce is considered a strong plus.

  • Robust organizational skills, attention to detail, and a proven ability to successfully manage multiple tasks at once.

  • A natural curiosity for discovering "the why" behind data and numbers, paired with an eagerness to learn data-driven decision-making.

ModMed Benefits Highlight: At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:

United States

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution,
  • 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep.
  • Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs,
  • Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs,
  • Company-sponsored Business Resource & Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed,
  • Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement programs and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning,
  • Global presence and in-person collaboration opportunities; dog-friendly HQ (US), Hybrid office-based roles and remote availability for some roles,
  • Weekly catered breakfast and lunch, treadmill workstations, Zen, and wellness rooms within our BRIC headquarters.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.

The High School Math Teacher is a highly qualified, state certified educator responsible for delivering specific course content in an online environment. Teachers provide instruction, support, and guidance, manage the learning process, and focus on students’ individual needs. Teachers monitor student progress through Stride K12’s learning management system. They actively work closely with students and parents/learning coaches to advance each student’s learning toward established goals. Teachers typically work from home but must travel occasionally throughout the year to various school functions, such as state testing or as otherwise required by the school.

K12, a Stride Company, believes in Education for ANY ONE. We provide families with an online option for a high-quality, personalized education experience. Students can thrive, find their passion, and learn in an environment that encourages discovery at their own pace.

Passionate Educators are needed at the Stride K12 partner school, Texas Virtual at Hallsville (TVAH). We want you to be a part of our talented team!

The mission of Texas Virtual at Hallsville (TVAH) is to provide an exemplary individualized and engaging educational experience for students by incorporating school and community/family partnerships coupled with a rigorous curriculum along with a data-driven and student-centered instructional model. Student success will be measured by valid and reliable assessment data, parent and student satisfaction, and continued institutional growth within the academic community. Join us!

This is a full-time position. Ability to work independently, typically 40+ hours per week is required. Ability to maintain a professional home office without distraction during workday, typically 9-5 (or 8-4) or as defined by the school.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • Provides rich and engaging synchronous and asynchronous learning experiences for students
  • Commitment to personalizing learning for all students
  • Demonstrates a belief in all students’ ability to succeed and meet high expectations
  • Differentiates instruction based on student level of mastery
  • Augments course content according to prescribed policies and procedures using appropriate asynchronous and synchronous tools under guidance from principal and coach
  • Maintains grade book ensuring student academic integrity, makes student placement and promotion decisions, and alerts administrators to concerns about student performance and progress
  • Prepares students for high stakes standardized tests
  • Understands that a primary responsibility is to establish and maintain positive rapport with families and regularly communicates with and responds to students and learning coaches/parents in a timely manner
  • Supports learning coaches/parents with student curricular and instructional issues, as well as basic troubleshooting in a virtual classroom environment that is in line with academy policies and procedures
  • Travels as required (on average once per month and/or approximately 20% of the time) for face-to-face professional development, student testing, and as required by school

REQUIRED MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree AND
  • Active state teaching license AND
  • Ability to clear required background check

DESIRED QUALIFICATION:

raw.description:
OVERVIEW

Civic Nation seeks a Research Assistant who will support Civic Nation’s democracy initiatives. The Research Assistant, reporting to the Director of Digital Strategy, will play a critical role in providing accurate election information to voters, fact-checking, and more. This position will also provide media and social monitoring of news development and research support.

This is a part-time temporary role for 20 hours per week, concluding December 15, 2026.

ABOUT THE COMMUNICATIONS TEAM

The Communications Team is focused on telling the story of Civic Nation’s work. Through creative messaging, digital activations, media relations, and more, the Communications Team amplifies the work of all Civic Nation initiatives and campaigns.

ABOUT CIVIC NATION

Civic Nation is an impact hub for the ideas, leaders, and initiatives that strengthen civic culture, civic power, and civic participation. We shift culture, systems, and policy by bringing together individuals, grassroots organizers, industry leaders, and influencers to tackle our nation’s most pressing social challenges. Five initiatives are a part of the Civic Nation family: ALL IN Campus Democracy Challenge, Change Collective, It’s On Us, We The Action, and When We All Vote.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Update the 50-state election deadline and law tracker daily, and monitor and record state and local election dates and law updates.
  • Develop issue one-pagers, memos, reports, explainers, and other documents detailing critical issues for Civic Nation’s democracy initiatives.
  • Monitor news and social media posts to aid the Communications team in responding to actionable items within relevant newscycles.
  • Track legislative, legal, and administrative developments regarding Civic Nation’s democracy initiatives.
  • Fact-check documents and other materials for accuracy in collaboration with the Research Contractor.
  • Maintain organized documentation and research files.
  • Other reasonable and relevant duties as assigned.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • 1+ years of research experience, including academic experience and internships.
  • 1+ years of experience in nonprofit and/or political environments, including internships.
  • Proficiency in Google Suite, including Google Sheets, Google Calendar, and Google Docs, and Asana.
  • Academic research experience, preferred.

YOUR COMPETENCIES

  • A strong commitment to democratic engagement and involvement with civic engagement activities.
  • Demonstrated experience balancing multiple projects on tight deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience translating large amounts of information into accessible explainers and memos.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • A self-starter, entrepreneurial, adaptable, and driven to take the initiative and complete tasks on deadline.
  • Ability to manage large amounts of information and spreadsheets.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong teamwork, critical thinking, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality.
  • A strong ability to listen, understand, connect, earn the trust of, and collaborate with employees at all levels of the organization.
  • Comfort in a rapidly changing environment and demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities at any given time.
  • Personal and professional commitment to promoting and investing in cross-cultural skills and awareness related to individuals from broad backgrounds, races, ethnicities, religions, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, and disability.

SALARY

The Washington, DC-based salary range for this position is $18.40/hour. This role will work 20 hours per week and conclude on December 15, 2026.

PROCESS TIMELINE

Candidates can expect the following hiring process and timeline (please note that this timeline may be subject to change):

  • August 25-August 27: First-Round Interviews
  • August 31: Writing Assignment
  • September 2-September 4: Final Interviews
  • September 9: Hiring Decision announced

All candidates will be notified via email of the status of their application on or before the completion of the search.

TO APPLY

To apply, submit a cover letter and resume below. The cover letter, addressed to Valeria Villarroel, should be concise, compelling, and include why you would like to work for Civic Nation. Applications will be accepted until August 16, 2026.

Driven by our values, Civic Nation aims to recruit candidates representative of the communities and populations we serve. Towards that goal, we know that a diverse workforce allows us to see issues facing our democracy in more nuanced ways, creating the thought leadership needed to fulfill our mission and reach our goals. Civic Nation is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes people from all backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives to apply.

raw.excerpt: ABOUT USAt DataEQ, we transform unstructured customer and public feedback into powerful, actionable insights.
raw.description:
ABOUT US

At DataEQ, we transform unstructured customer and public feedback into powerful, actionable insights. By combining cutting-edge AI with our unique human data labeling platform, we help some of South Africa’s leading companies—including top banks, retailers, and insurers—enhance customer experiences, manage risk, and optimize digital services.

Our innovative solutions are driving real impact across industries that matter.

When you join DataEQ, you become part of a dynamic and diverse team of over talented professionals, including data scientists, analysts, product specialists and creative problem-solvers. We’re committed to fostering a collaborative, supportive environment where fresh ideas and innovation thrive.

With a strong focus on innovation and a deep commitment to client success, we empower our teams to deliver meaningful work that matters.

If you’re passionate about building long-term client relationships, driving value, and supporting strategic account growth conversations, DataEQ is the place for you.

ABOUT THE JOB

We’re looking for an Account Director to manage a portfolio of key client accounts across industries such as financial services, telecoms, and retail. Reporting to the MD of the DataEQ Core division, you’ll work closely with clients and internal teams to ensure smooth delivery, client satisfaction, and ongoing growth.

You will be the primary point of contact for your accounts, responsible for retention, renewals, and upselling opportunities, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to tailor solutions that meet client needs.

This is a remote-first position, offering autonomy, collaboration, and the opportunity to make a measurable impact.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING DAY-TO-DAY

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of enterprise client accounts
  • Build and nurture trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders
  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling within your accounts
  • Lead renewals and manage RFP/RFQ processes as required
  • Prepare cost estimates and proposals for clients
  • Collaborate with the finance team to resolve billing and payment matters
  • Coordinate with Product, Analytics, and Delivery teams to ensure client needs are met
  • Monitor and ensure the quality and impact of deliverables align with client goals
  • Manage account planning, forecasting, and performance reporting
  • Identify and mitigate risks to client satisfaction and retention
  • Support and mentor junior Account Managers, where applicable
  • Report regularly on account performance and pipeline to senior leadership

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

The ideal candidate will combine strategic leadership, commercial acumen, and exceptional relationship-building skills. While specific requirements may vary, we generally look for the following qualities and experience:

Experience & Qualifications

  • Tertiary qualification in a relevant field
  • 3-5 years of experience in a client-facing or account management role (preferably in tech, consulting SaaS, or data-driven services)
  • Strong communication skills - verbal, written, and presentation
  • Commercially minded with experience supporting revenue growth
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable with MS Office and web-based client management tools

Bonus Points For

  • People management or mentorship experience
  • Consulting, customer success, or data solution delivery background
  • Experience in financial services, telecoms, or retail industries
  • Familiarity with customer data, sentiment analysis, or social listening platforms

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING WITH US

At DataEQ, we believe in supporting our team—professionally and personally. We value outcomes over inputs and offer a flexible, remote-first work culture where you can thrive.

While we’re globally distributed, most of our team is based in Johannesburg and Cape Town. If you're local, you’ll enjoy opportunities to co-work on Together Tuesdays, attend regular social events, and connect face-to-face.

Here’s what you can expect when you join DataEQ:

  • Remote-first work culture with flexibility and autonomy
  • Market-related remuneration (including generous bonus structure)
  • Generous annual leave
  • Birthday lie-in - enjoy a slower start to your special day
  • Long-term service compensation after 5 years and 10 years
  • Pension and group life insurance (compulsory)
  • Optional medical aid
  • A solid work-from-home set-up, which includes a contribution towards your WFH expenses
  • Access to co-working spaces in Johannesburg and Cape Town
  • Regular team updates to keep everyone aligned and engaged
  • Fun social events and opportunities to connect informally

If you’re a strategic relationship-driven professional excited about helping clients succeed and growing your career, we’d love to hear from you.

You agree to the disclosure of your Personal Information by DataEQ to any third party, where DataEQ has a legal or contractual duty to disclose such Personal Information. You further agree to the disclosure of your Personal Information for any reason enabling DataEQ to carry out or to comply with any business or legal obligation DataEQ may have or to pursue a legitimate interest of DataEQ, in order for DataEQ to assess you for the job position for which you are applying.

raw.description:
Senior Manager, Food & Beverage Category Management

Reports To – VP, Category Management

Location – Remote (U.S.) w/ travel up to 25%

Full-Time, Exempt

About Legends Global

Legends Global is the premier partner to the world’s greatest live events, venues, and brands. We deliver a fully integrated solution of premium services that keeps our partners front and center through our white-label approach. Our network of 450 venues worldwide, hosting 20,000 events and entertaining 165 million guests each year, is powered by our depth of expertise and level of execution across every component — feasibility & consulting, owner’s representation, sales, partnerships, hospitality, merchandise, venue management, and content & booking — of world-class live events and venues.

The Legends Global culture is one of respect, ambitious thinking, collaboration, and bold action. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can be authentic, make an impact, and grow their career. Winning is an everyday thing at Legends Global.

The Opportunity

We are building a centralized Category Management function to transform how Legends Global sources, contracts, and manages the goods and services that power our portfolio of stadiums, arenas, convention centers, theatres, amphitheaters, and attractions. The Senior Manager, Food & Beverage Category Management will own the strategic sourcing lifecycle for all related categories across this diverse portfolio.

This is a high-impact role that requires someone who can navigate a complex operating model where central procurement influences but does not mandate venue-level purchasing decisions. You will develop category strategies, negotiate enterprise agreements, and build supplier partnerships that deliver measurable value—while respecting that each venue operates under unique client requirements and local conditions.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Food & Beverage Category Management is a strategic procurement leader responsible for developing and executing comprehensive category strategies across Legends' portfolio of venues globally. This role will drive enterprise-wide procurement excellence across all food and beverage goods, and related services categories supporting our venue operations, concessions programs, premium hospitality experiences, and guest services.

Reporting to the VP of Category Management, this position will aggregate spend, rationalize suppliers, negotiate national contracts, optimize costs, and build strategic supplier partnerships that deliver measurable value to Legends and our venue partners. The Sr. Manager will serve as the subject matter expert for all F&B and Hospitality related procurement activities, partnering closely with operations, finance, culinary teams, and venue leadership to balance cost, quality, innovation, and service delivery.

This is a high-impact role requiring deep category expertise, sophisticated negotiation skills, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to influence stakeholders across a decentralized operating model where venues maintain operational autonomy.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Category Management

  • Develop and execute multi-year category strategies for food, beverage, hospitality goods, and related services categories across the Legends portfolio
  • Lead spend analysis, market assessments, and total cost of ownership (TCO) evaluations to identify consolidation and optimization opportunities
  • Design and implement supplier rationalization initiatives that balance standardization with venue-specific operational requirements
  • Build and maintain category roadmaps that align procurement initiatives with broader business objectives and growth strategies
  • Partner with culinary leadership and operations teams on menu engineering initiatives that optimize product mix, cost structures, and guest satisfaction
  • Establish category performance benchmarks, KPIs, and dashboards to track savings, compliance, supplier performance, and program adoption

Sourcing & Contract Negotiation

  • Lead strategic sourcing events (RFIs, RFPs, etc.) for national and regional agreements across all assigned categories
  • Negotiate complex, multi-year master agreements and pricing structures that deliver competitive pricing, favorable terms, and operational flexibility
  • Structure innovative deal frameworks including volume commitments, rebates, marketing funds, performance incentives, and cost escalation protections
  • Develop standardized contract templates, rate or pricing schedules, SLAs, and terms & conditions for F&B and hospitality categories
  • Manage contract lifecycle activities including renewals, amendments, price reviews, and supplier performance evaluations
  • Build strong supplier partnerships with key broadline distributors (e.g., Sysco, US Foods), center-of-plate providers, produce suppliers, specialty/gourmet vendors, beverage suppliers (alcohol and non-alcohol), and hospitality goods manufacturers

Supplier Relationship Management

  • Cultivate strategic relationships with senior leadership at key supplier organizations
  • Conduct quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with top-tier suppliers to evaluate performance, address issues, and identify innovation opportunities
  • Organize product cuttings, menu tastings, and supplier showcases to introduce new products, trends, and cost-saving alternatives to venue or corporate stakeholders
  • Facilitate joint business planning sessions with suppliers to align on growth initiatives, promotional calendars, and supply chain resilience strategies
  • Establish supplier scorecards and performance metrics tied to quality, service, delivery, innovation, and value creation
  • Resolve escalated supplier issues including product quality concerns, delivery failures, pricing disputes, and service gaps

Stakeholder Engagement & Change Management

  • Build consensus and drive adoption of national contracts across a decentralized venue network where mandates are not enforceable
  • Develop compelling value propositions, business cases, and ROI analyses that demonstrate the benefits of consolidated procurement programs
  • Conduct venue roadshows, webinars, and training sessions to educate stakeholders on available contracts, ordering processes, and program benefits
  • Partner with finance teams to track rebate accruals, validate supplier payments, and reconcile discrepancies
  • Collaborate with operations, culinary, and hospitality leadership to ensure procurement strategies support operational excellence and guest experience goals
  • Serve as trusted advisor to venue GMs, executive chefs, and F&B directors on product specifications, supplier selection, and cost optimization strategies

Program Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with corporate procurement policies, contracting authorities, ethical sourcing standards, and regulatory requirements
  • Maintain accurate category documentation including contracts, rate sheets, approved supplier lists, specifications, and program guidelines
  • Support internal and external audits by providing procurement documentation, spend reports, and compliance evidence
  • Monitor supplier compliance with contractual commitments including pricing, service levels, insurance requirements, and diversity commitments

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Hospitality Management, Culinary Arts, or related field required; MBA or relevant advanced degree preferred
  • 8+ years of progressive procurement or category management experience with at least 5 years focused on food, beverage, and/or hospitality categories
  • 3+ years of experience in a leadership or senior individual contributor role managing complex, multi-stakeholder procurement programs
  • Proven track record of delivering measurable cost savings, process improvements, and supplier performance enhancements in a high-volume, fast-paced environment

Industry & Category Expertise

  • Deep knowledge of food and beverage supply chains including broadline distribution, center-of-plate proteins, produce, dairy, specialty/gourmet ingredients, and dry goods
  • Strong understanding of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverage categories including beer, wine, spirits, soft drinks, energy drinks, coffee, and other beverages
  • Familiarity with hospitality goods and services categories including smallwares, F&B disposables, linens, tabletop, and guest amenities
  • Understanding of foodservice equipment categories including cooking equipment, refrigeration, warewashing, beverage systems, and kitchen smallwares
  • Experience working with nationally recognized suppliers in the hospitality, restaurant, sports venue, entertainment, travel, or leisure industries
  • Knowledge of back-of-house (BOH) and front-of-house (FOH) operations is highly valued; culinary or F&B operations background is a strong plus
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); advanced Excel skills strongly preferred
  • Business acumen with understanding of P&L dynamics, margin structures, rebate programs, and cost allocation models
  • Strong executive presence with ability to present confidently to C-suite audiences, supplier executives, and cross-functional leadership teams
  • Proficiency with procurement tools and technologies including spend analytics platforms, eProcurement tools, contract lifecycle management (CLM) systems, and ERP systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in sports, entertainment, hospitality, restaurants, hotels, convention centers, or similar high-volume, guest-facing environments
  • Knowledge of sustainability practices, local sourcing initiatives, and ethical procurement standards in food and hospitality industries
  • Familiarity with menu engineering principles, recipe costing, and bill-of-materials (BOM) structures for F&B operations
  • Experience managing national or multi-site procurement programs for organizations with $100M+ in annual spend

WORKING CONDITIONS

Location: This role will be remote. Up to 25% domestic travel to venue sites, supplier facilities, and industry events. Travel will be concentrated around company meetings, RFP presentations, supplier negotiations, venue onboarding, product cuttings, and quarterly business reviews.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

NOTE:

The essential responsibilities of this position are described under the headings above. They may be subject to change at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons. Also, this document in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position.

Legends Global is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer, and encourages Women, Minorities, Individuals with Disabilities, and protected Veterans to apply. VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

raw.title: Associate Medical Director / Oncologist (Canada)
raw.excerpt: Chez Allucent™, nous nous engageons à aider les petites et moyennes entreprises biopharmaceutiques à naviguer efficacement dans l’univers complexe des essais cliniques afin d’offrir des traitements qui changent la vie aux patients qui en ont besoin partout dans le monde.
raw.description:
Chez Allucent™, nous nous engageons à aider les petites et moyennes entreprises biopharmaceutiques à naviguer efficacement dans l’univers complexe des essais cliniques afin d’offrir des traitements qui changent la vie aux patients qui en ont besoin partout dans le monde.

Nous recherchons un directeur médical adjoint pour rejoindre notre équipe d’élite (télétravail). En tant que directeur médical adjoint chez Allucent, vous serez chargé de veiller, de manière autonome, à l’intégrité et à la qualité des aspects médicaux, cliniques et de sécurité des essais menés par Allucent. Vous servirez de personne-ressource en tant que moniteur médical dans les protocoles d’étude auprès des chercheurs et des équipes des centres d’étude pour toute question relative au protocole et à la sécurité des participants recrutés. Une expérience en oncologie est obligatoire pour ce poste.

Dans le cadre de ce poste, vos principales tâches consisteront à :

  • Fournir de manière autonome un soutien en matière de surveillance médicale aux études cliniques qui vous sont attribuées, par exemple en répondant aux questions d’ordre médical posées par l’équipe de l’étude et/ou le site, en aidant à l’interprétation du protocole et à l’examen médical des données générées, y compris, mais sans s’y limiter, les données de laboratoire clinique et les formulaires de rapport de cas, selon les besoins, afin de garantir le respect du protocole, la cohérence et la validité scientifique des données. Au besoin, et avec l’appui nécessaire de ses supérieurs, aider le gestionnaire de projet dans les discussions avec les clients concernant les questions ou les préoccupations liées à la sécurité qui pourraient avoir été soulevées.
  • Préparer les plans de surveillance médicale et autres plans pertinents pour les études assignées menées par Allucent avant le début de l’étude et conformément aux livrables prévus dans le contrat.
  • Examiner les événements indésirables graves, les SUSAR, les rapports de sécurité et effectuer l’analyse des événements similaires.
  • Assister l’équipe de gestion des données cliniques dans le codage MedDRA et OMS pour les essais assignés.
  • Contribuer à l’examen des documents relatifs aux études cliniques afin d’en vérifier la cohérence et la pertinence sur le plan médical, avec l’appui des membres chevronnés de l’équipe médicale au besoin, notamment, mais sans s’y limiter, le protocole d’essai clinique (CTP), le formulaire de consentement éclairé (ICF) et le rapport d’étude clinique (CSR), ainsi que d’autres rapports sur l’innocuité (p. ex., DSUR, PSUR)
  • Contribuer à la mise en place et à la conduite des comités de sécurité des données (DSMB, DMB ou équivalents) et des réunions d’augmentation de la dose (DEC)
  • Assister, participer et faire des présentations lors de la réunion de lancement, de la réunion des chercheurs et d’autres réunions pertinentes dans le cadre des projets attribués, selon les besoins.
  • Fournir un soutien médical d’urgence 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7, pour des conseils médicaux et de sécurité, au besoin
  • Assurer la formation des équipes de projet sur les aspects médicaux de l’essai et la formation thérapeutique, au besoin
  • Examen des écarts par rapport au protocole
  • Cerner les risques liés à l’étude et contribuer à l’élaboration du plan de gestion des risques
  • Examiner et comprendre les livrables médicaux de l’étude tels qu’ils sont définis dans le contrat de l’étude assignée, avec l’appui de collègues plus expérimentés, et contribuer au suivi des dépenses budgétaires tout au long des études qui leur sont confiées
  • Assiste à d’importantes conférences sur les traitements thérapeutiques et le développement de médicaments, et peut être amené à y faire une présentation
  • Assure une bonne communication et entretient de bonnes relations avec les (futurs) clients
  • Contribue et participe, avec le soutien de collègues plus expérimentés si nécessaire, aux évaluations des clients, aux visites et aux présentations d’offres

Requirements

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous devrez posséder :

  • un diplôme de docteur en médecine (MD)
  • une expérience en tant qu’oncologue
  • au moins trois ans d’expérience professionnelle pertinente, avec une solide expertise en oncologie
  • une bonne connaissance des normes GxP
  • une situation en règle auprès des autorités de réglementation et d’agrément locales, provinciales (aux États-Unis) et nationales, ainsi qu’auprès des organismes de certification
  • Connaissance des exigences réglementaires applicables (locales), notamment celles du RGPD/HIPAA, du CFR/CTR/CTD
